items.title: IAS applications for membership in the school of mathematics
items.excerpt: The IAS has opened its application page for its membership program for the upcoming year. This by itself would be unremarkable — the program does this every year — but there is an additional statement included in the announcement: We realize that applying to positions in the current environment is stressful. To help alleviate this, […]
items.title_zh: IAS 数学学院会员申请
items.excerpt_zh: IAS 已经开放了来年会员计划的申请页面。这本身并不引人注目——该计划每年都会这样做——但公告中还包含一项附加声明：我们意识到在当前环境下申请职位压力很大。为了帮助缓解这种情况，[...]

items.title: A Response to “Who will become the new mathematicians of Math 2.0?”
items.excerpt: “This is a response to a recent post on Proofs and Prompts titled ‘Who will become the new mathematicians of Math 2.0?’ written by an Anonymous PhD student (who I will refer to as ‘Anonymous’ below). I would urge particularly all tenured and tenure-track mathematicians to read it because there are many students that think the same way, and are planning to leave academia as a consequence. […]”
items.title_zh: 回应“谁将成为数学2.0的新数学家？”
items.excerpt_zh: “这是对最近一篇题为“谁将成为数学 2.0 的新数学家？”的帖子的回应，该帖子由一位匿名博士生（我在下面将其称为“匿名”）撰写。我特别敦促所有终身教授和终身教授数学家阅读该文章，因为有很多学生也有同样的想法，并计划因此离开学术界。[...]”

items.title: Disgusted by AI?
items.excerpt: I completely disagree with the notion that AI companies have hijacked our mathematical culture and turned it into something new and unrecognizable. They have just taken our existing culture to its extreme.
items.title_zh: 厌恶人工智能？
items.excerpt_zh: 我完全不同意人工智能公司劫持了我们的数学文化并将其变成新的、无法识别的东西的观点。他们刚刚将我们现有的文化发挥到了极致。

items.title: Towards a world mathematical commons
items.excerpt: Mathematics is changing and growing beyond us. Here's what we can do about it.
items.title_zh: 迈向世界数学共享
items.excerpt_zh: 数学正在改变并超越我们。我们可以采取以下措施。

items.title: Simultaneous popular polynomial differences in higher dimensions
items.excerpt: We extend the simultaneous popular polynomial difference theorem of Conlon, Dong, and the author to polynomial shifts along prescribed directions in $\mathbb{F}_p^D$. Let $P_1,\ldots,P_k\in\mathbb{Z}[t]$ be linearly independent polynomials with zero constant terms, and let $v_1,\ldots,v_k\in\mathbb{Z}^D\setminus\{0\}$. We show that, for every $\varepsilon>0$, every sufficiently large prime $p$, and every $A\subseteq\mathbb{F}_p^D$ of density $\alpha$, there exists a nonzero $d\in\mathbb{F}_p$ such that \[ \mathbb{E}_{\underline{x}\in\mathbb{F}_p^D} \mathbf{1}_A(\underline{x}) \prod_{\substack{1\leq i\leq k\\ \omega_i=1}} \mathbf{1}_A\bigl(\underline{x}+P_i(d)v_i\bigr) \geq \alpha^{\,1+\sum_{i=1}^k\omega_i}-\varepsilon \] simultaneously for every $\omega\in\{0,1\}^k$. The main new ingredient is a directional arithmetic regularity decomposition adapted to mixed directional box norms.
items.title_zh: 高维中同时流行的多项式差
items.excerpt_zh: 我们将 Conlon、Dong 和作者的同步流行多项式差分定理扩展到 $\mathbb{F}_p^D$ 中沿规定方向的多项式平移。令 $P_1,\ldots,P_k\in\mathbb{Z}[t]$ 为常数项为零的线性独立多项式，并令 $v_1,\ldots,v_k\in\mathbb{Z}^D\setminus\{0\}$。我们证明，对于每个 $\varepsilon>0$、每个足够大的素数 $p$ 以及密度 $\alpha$ 的每个 $A\subseteq\mathbb{F}_p^D$，都存在一个非零 $d\in\mathbb{F}_p$ 使得 \[ \mathbb{E}_{\underline{x}\in\mathbb{F}_p^D} \mathbf{1}_A(\underline{x}) \prod_{\substack{1\leq i\leq k\\ \omega_i=1}} \mathbf{1}_A\bigl(\underline{x}+P_i(d)v_i\bigr) \geq \alpha^{\,1+\sum_{i=1}^k\omega_i}-\varepsilon \] 同时对于每个$\omega\in\{0,1\}^k$。主要的新成分是适应混合方向盒范数的方向算术正则分解。

items.title: An explicit elementary proof of no Landau--Siegel zeros
items.excerpt: We give an elementary proof of the absence of Landau--Siegel zeros with the explicit constant $c=1/100$. For every primitive quadratic Dirichlet character $\chi$ of conductor $q\ge3$, each real zero $\beta\in(0,1)$ of $L(s,\chi)$ satisfies $(1-\beta)\log q>c$. The proof combines integer coefficient counting, polynomial congruences, a paired-tail hyperbola estimate, and a logarithmically weighted comparison of positive sums. All required constants are explicit, and one choice of parameters covers every conductor. The argument uses elementary arithmetic and real summation and integration, without separate zero computations for small conductors.
items.title_zh: 不存在朗道--西格尔零点的显式基本证明
items.excerpt_zh: 我们用显式常数 $c=1/100$ 给出了不存在朗道-西格尔零点的基本证明。对于导体$q\ge3$的每个本原二次狄利克雷特征$\chi$，$L(s,\chi)$的每个实零$\beta\in(0,1)$满足$(1-\beta)\log q>c$。该证明结合了整数系数计数、多项式同余、双尾双曲线估计以及正和的对数加权比较。所有必需的常数都是明确的，并且参数的一种选择涵盖了每个导体。该论证使用初等算术和实数求和与积分，无需对小导体进行单独的零计算。

items.title: Norm-Euclideanity in cyclic fields
items.excerpt: Consider a cyclic number field of prime degree $p$. For a fixed degree, there are only finitely many such fields which are norm-Euclidean. When $p=2$ or $3$, these have been completely determined. If instead $p>3$, one can bound the discriminant of such fields from above. We substantially sharpen these upper bounds via an explicit Burgess-type criterion and describe a method for completely resolving other small prime cases.
items.title_zh: 循环域中的范数欧几里德性
items.excerpt_zh: 考虑素数 $p$ 的循环数域。对于固定度数，只有有限多个这样的范欧几里得域。当$p=2$或$3$时，这些已经完全确定了。相反，如果 $p>3$，则可以从上面限制这些字段的判别式。我们通过显式的伯吉斯型准则大幅锐化这些上限，并描述了一种完全解决其他小素数情况的方法。

items.title: On the Open Problem in the 2023 Simon Marais Mathematics Competition
items.excerpt: We prove that, for $n \in \mathbb{Z}^+$ not a perfect square, the only pairs of positive integers $\{a, b\}$ for which there exists $r \in \mathbb{R}$ such that $r^a + \sqrt{n}$ and $r^b + \sqrt{n}$ are both rational numbers are those of the form $\{a, a\}$ or $\{g, 2g\}$ (with $g$ odd). This resolves an open question presented in the 2023 Simon Marais Mathematics Competition.
items.title_zh: 论2023年西蒙·马莱数学竞赛的开放问题
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明，对于 $n \in \mathbb{Z}^+$ 不是完全平方数，唯一存在 $r \in \mathbb{R}$ 的正整数对 $\{a, b\}$ 使得 $r^a + \sqrt{n}$ 和 $r^b + \sqrt{n}$ 都是有理数，其形式为 $\{a, a\}$ 或 $\{g, 2g\}$ （其中$g$ 奇数）。这解决了 2023 年 Simon Marais 数学竞赛中提出的一个悬而未决的问题。

items.title: Aspects of quadratic Chabauty via modular forms
items.excerpt: We develop algorithms to construct a basis of de Rham cohomology for modular curves and a matrix representing the Hodge filtration required in the quadratic Chabauty method. We do this without requiring an explicit plane model of the curve and instead compute these objects in terms of modular forms. Our approach works for any modular curve; to demonstrate its efficiency, we implement our method for nonsplit Cartan modular curves.
items.title_zh: 通过模块化形式的二次 Chabauty 方面
items.excerpt_zh: 我们开发了算法来构建模曲线的 de Rham 上同调基础以及表示二次 Chabauty 方法中所需的 Hodge 过滤的矩阵。我们这样做不需要曲线的显式平面模型，而是以模块化形式计算这些对象。我们的方法适用于任何模块化曲线；为了证明其效率，我们实现了非分裂嘉当模曲线的方法。

items.title: Complete Determination of the Gallai--van der Waerden Number \(\mathrm{GW}(r;3,3)\)
items.excerpt: This paper completely determines the Gallai--van der Waerden number \(\mathrm{GW}(r;3,3)\) for all integers \(r\ge 3\): \[ \mathrm{GW}(3;3,3)=\mathrm{GW}(4;3,3)=9,\qquad \mathrm{GW}(r;3,3)=r\quad (r\ge 5). \]
items.title_zh: 加莱的完全确定--范德韦尔登数 \(\mathrm{GW}(r;3,3)\)
items.excerpt_zh: 本文完全确定了所有整数\(r\ge 3\)的Gallai--van der Waerden数\(\mathrm{GW}(r;3,3)\)：\[ \mathrm{GW}(3;3,3)=\mathrm{GW}(4;3,3)=9,\qquad \mathrm{GW}(r;3,3)=r\quad (r\ge 5)。 \]

items.title: OpenAI partially disproves Littlewood's 1961 $L^\alpha$-flat theorem
items.excerpt: We present a counterexample, produced by OpenAI, to Littlewood's 1961 theorem on $L^\alpha$-flat polynomials. The theorem asserts that no $L^\alpha$-flat polynomials exist within the class of trigonometric polynomials of the form$$\sum_{m=1}^{n} a_m \cos(m\theta+\alpha_m), \qquad n \in \mathbb{N}^*,$$satisfying$$k\, n^2 \sum_{m=1}^{n} a_m^2 \;\leq\; \sum_{m=1}^{n} m^2 a_m^2,$$where $k$ is an absolute constant (alternatively expressed on the right-hand side as $K = 1/k$). We show that OpenAI's counterexample is contained within the class of hyper-lacunary sequences. Consequently, it offers only a limited refutation, as such sequences fail to satisfy an implicit assumption of Littlewood's theorem. We also discuss broader questions surrounding this counterexample and provide a brief historical overview.
items.title_zh: OpenAI 部分反驳了 Littlewood 1961 年的 $L^\alpha$-平坦定理
items.excerpt_zh: 我们提出了一个由 OpenAI 制作的反例，针对 Littlewood 1961 年关于 $L^\alpha$-平坦多项式的定理。该定理断言 $$\sum_{m=1}^{n} a_m \cos(m\theta+\alpha_m), \qquad n \in \mathbb{N}^*,$$satisfying$$k\, n^2 \sum_{m=1}^{n} a_m^2 形式的三角多项式类中不存在 $L^\alpha$ 平坦多项式\;\leq\; \sum_{m=1}^{n} m^2 a_m^2,$$其中 $k$ 是绝对常数（或者在右侧表示为 $K = 1/k$）。我们证明 OpenAI 的反例包含在超空白序列类别中。因此，它仅提供有限的反驳，因为此类序列无法满足利特尔伍德定理的隐含假设。我们还讨论了围绕这个反例的更广泛的问题，并提供了简短的历史概述。

items.title: The exponent $1/4$ in three complexity bounds: integer bases, continued fractions, and the $(3/2)^n$ steering word
items.excerpt: Let $\xi$ be a real algebraic irrational number and $p(n,\xi,b)$ the number of distinct blocks of length $n$ in its base-$b$ expansion. Bugeaud and Evertse proved in 2008 that $p(n,\xi,b)/(n(\log n)^\eta)$ is unbounded for every $\eta<1/11$. We prove this for every $\eta<1/4$. We also prove the analogous bound for the continued fraction expansion of an algebraic number of degree at least three, with every exponent $\delta<1/4$. Bugeaud announced this statement in 2013 with an unspecified $\delta>0$. Finally, the subword complexity of the steering word of $(3/2)^n$ exceeds $C\,k(\log k)^\eta$ infinitely often for every $\eta<1/4$ and every $C$. The three proofs share one count: $\varepsilon^{-1}$ classes times $\varepsilon^{-3}$ subspaces from the quantitative Subspace Theorem of Evertse and Ferretti. The subspaces are then disposed of at the cost of a logarithm, with no further power of $\varepsilon^{-1}$. All three results, and the quantitative Subspace Theorem they rest on, are machine-verified in Lean~4.
items.title_zh: 指数 $1/4$ 在三个复杂度范围内：整数基数、连分数和 $(3/2)^n$ 控制字
items.excerpt_zh: 设 $\xi$ 为实代数无理数，$p(n,\xi,b)$ 为其基 $b$ 扩展中长度为 $n$ 的不同块的数量。 Bugeaud 和 Evertse 在 2008 年证明，对于每个 $\eta<1/11$，$p(n,\xi,b)/(n(\log n)^\eta)$ 是无界的。我们对每个 $\eta<1/4$ 证明了这一点。我们还证明了至少三阶代数数的连分式展开的类似界限，每个指数 $\delta<1/4$。 Bugeaud 在 2013 年宣布了这一声明，但未指定 $\delta>0$。最后，对于每个 $\eta<1/4$ 和每个 $C$，$(3/2)^n$ 的控制字的子字复杂度经常无限地超过 $C\,k(\log k)^\eta$。这三个证明共享一个计数：$\varepsilon^{-1}$ 类乘以 Evertse 和 Ferretti 定量子空间定理中的 $\varepsilon^{-3}$ 子空间。然后以对数为代价处理子空间，不再有 $\varepsilon^{-1}$ 的幂。所有三个结果以及它们所依据的定量子空间定理均在 Lean~4 中进行了机器验证。

items.title: Connected graphs with equal independence number and radius
items.excerpt: A classical theorem states that the independence number of any connected graph is at least its radius. In 2007, DeLaVi\~na, Pepper, and Waller proved that every connected graph with equal independence number and radius is traceable. We first give a new short proof of this theorem and then prove two results for graphs of higher connectivity. (1) Every 2-connected graph with equal independence number and radius is Hamiltonian. (2) Every 3-connected graph with equal independence number and radius is Hamiltonian-connected and pancyclic. Several lemmas used in the proofs are of independent interest.
items.title_zh: 独立数和半径相等的连通图
items.excerpt_zh: 经典定理指出，任何连通图的独立数至少是其半径。 2007年，DeLaVi\~na、Pepper和Waller证明了每个独立数和半径相等的连通图都是可追踪的。我们首先给出这个定理的一个新的简短证明，然后证明更高连通性图的两个结果。 (1) 凡独立数和半径相等的二连通图都是哈密顿图。 (2) 凡是具有相等独立数和半径的三连通图都是哈密顿连通且全环的。证明中使用的几个引理具有独立的意义。

items.title: Exact Realization of Edge and Induced Three-Vertex Subgraph Counts
items.excerpt: The study of three-vertex subgraph densities has developed along two complementary lines: exact finite realization in large graphs of a given order, and asymptotic approximate realization by sequences of graphs. We bridge these viewpoints for the edge density and the four induced three-vertex subgraph densities. By analyzing local modifications of finite samples from graphons, we show that, for any nonempty subset of these densities, every asymptotically feasible target vector lying a fixed positive distance from the boundary of the corresponding feasible region is realized exactly by a graph of every sufficiently large order, subject only to the natural arithmetic constraints. Thus, in the interior of these feasible regions, asymptotic feasibility implies exact finite realizability up to the unavoidable arithmetic obstructions.
items.title_zh: 边和诱导三顶点子图计数的精确实现
items.excerpt_zh: 三顶点子图密度的研究沿着两条互补的路线发展：给定阶的大图中的精确有限实现，以及图序列的渐近近似实现。我们将边缘密度和四个诱导的三顶点子图密度的这些观点联系起来。通过分析图元中有限样本的局部修改，我们表明，对于这些密度的任何非空子集，距相应可行区域边界固定正距离的每个渐近可行目标向量都可以通过每个足够大阶的图精确实现，仅受自然算术约束。因此，在这些可行区域的内部，渐近可行性意味着精确的有限可实现性，直至不可避免的算术障碍。

items.title: An elementary proof of a tight $\Delta+1$ bound for the additive chromatic number
items.excerpt: An additive coloring assigns positive integer labels to the vertices of a graph so that adjacent vertices have different sums of their neighbors' labels. The additive chromatic number $\eta(G)$ is the least $k$ for which labels from $[k]$ suffice. We give an elementary orientation argument proving that every finite simple graph $G$ satisfies $\eta(G) \leq \Delta(G) + 1$. This argument yields a $(\Delta(G) + 1)$-additive-coloring in polynomial time and improves upon the current best bound of $\eta(G) \leq \Delta(G)^{2} - \Delta(G) + 1$, valid for $\Delta(G) \geq 2$, from Akbari, Ghanbari, Manaviyat, and Zare.
items.title_zh: 加性色数的严格 $\Delta+1$ 界限的基本证明
items.excerpt_zh: 加法着色将正整数标签分配给图的顶点，以便相邻顶点具有不同的邻居标签总和。加性色数 $\eta(G)$ 是 $[k]$ 中的标签足以满足的最小 $k$。我们给出一个基本方向论证，证明每个有限简单图 $G$ 满足 $\eta(G) \leq \Delta(G) + 1$。此参数在多项式时间内产生 $(\Delta(G) + 1)$ 加法着色，并改进了 $\eta(G) \leq \Delta(G)^{2} - \Delta(G) + 1$ 的当前最佳界限，对 $\Delta(G) \geq 2$ 有效，来自 Akbari、Ghanbari、Manaviyat 和 Zare。

items.title: Inverting Dependently Random Tournaments
items.excerpt: Let $\text{inv}(T)$ be the inversion index of the tournament $T$. Answering a question of Behague, we show that $\text{inv}(T_1\to T_2)=\text{inv}(T_1)+\text{inv}(T_2)$ does not even hold asymptotically.
items.title_zh: 反转相关随机锦标赛
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $\text{inv}(T)$ 为锦标赛 $T$ 的反转索引。回答 Behague 的问题，我们证明 $\text{inv}(T_1\to T_2)=\text{inv}(T_1)+\text{inv}(T_2)$ 甚至不渐近成立。

items.title: Syzygy and Adjoint Matroids
items.excerpt: We give a matroid-theoretic analogue of Gaussian elimination and use it to construct, for every matroid M, the syzygy matroid Syz(M) on the collection of circuits of M. Dualizing the construction yields the combinatorial adjoint Adj(M) on the collection of maximal proper flats of M, and the two are related by Adj(M) \simeq Syz(M*). Neither construction depends on a realization. We determine Syz(M) when M is U_{k,k+3} or the Vamos matroid V_{8}. We also show that Adj(M) is an adjoint of M when M has rank 3. When M has rank 4 and V_{8} is a restriction of M, Adj(M) has rank 3 and is not an adjoint of M.
items.title_zh: Syzygy 和伴随矩阵
items.excerpt_zh: 我们给出高斯消去法的拟阵理论模拟，并用它为每个拟阵 M 构造 M 的电路集合上的齐合拟阵 Syz(M)。对偶化该构造产生 M 的最大固有平坦集合上的组合伴随 Adj(M)，并且两者通过 Adj(M) \simeq Syz(M*) 相关。两种构造都依赖于实现。当 M 为 U_{k,k+3} 或 Vamos 拟阵 V_{8} 时，我们确定 Syz(M)。我们还证明，当 M 的秩为 3 时，Adj(M) 是 M 的伴随。当 M 的秩为 4 并且 V_{8} 是 M 的限制时，Adj(M) 的秩为 3，并且不是 M 的伴随。

items.title: Cographs in chordal graphs
items.excerpt: For a graph $G$, let $\text{cg}(G)$ be the maximum $k\in \mathbb N$ for which $G$ contains a $k$-vertex cograph as an induced subgraph. The Erd\H{o}s-Hajnal conjecture asserts that for every proper hereditary graph class $\mathcal{G}$, there exists $\gamma\in(0,1]$ such that every $n$-vertex graph $G\in\mathcal{G}$ satisfies $\text{cg}(G)\geq n^\gamma$. This is still open; however, for some hereditary classes, one may guarantee much stronger bounds. For instance, every chordal graph $G$ on $n\geq 2$ vertices satisfies $\text{cg}(G)\geq n/(2\log n)$. Paul Seymour asked whether this bound is optimal up to a constant factor. We answer this affirmatively, even for interval graphs: For every integer $n\geq 2$, we construct an $n$-vertex interval graph $G$ with $\text{cg}(G)<64n/\log n$.
items.title_zh: 和弦图中的 Cographs
items.excerpt_zh: 对于图 $G$，令 $\text{cg}(G)$ 为最大 $k\in \mathbb N$，其中 $G$ 包含一个 $k$ 顶点共图作为导出子图。 Erd\H{o}s-Hajnal 猜想断言，对于每个真遗传图类 $\mathcal{G}$，都存在 $\gamma\in(0,1]$，使得每个 $n$-顶点图 $G\in\mathcal{G}$ 满足 $\text{cg}(G)\geq n^\gamma$。这仍然是开放的；但是，对于某些遗传类，可以保证更强例如，$n\geq 2$ 顶点上的每个弦图 $G$ 都满足 $\text{cg}(G)\geq n/(2\log n)$。Paul Seymour 询问，即使对于区间图，这个边界是否最优：对于每个整数 $n\geq 2$，我们构造一个 $n$ 顶点区间图 $G$ $\text{cg}(G)<64n/\log n$。

items.title: Permutation classes need not have proper growth rates
items.excerpt: By the Marcus-Tardos Theorem (formerly the Stanley-Wilf Conjecture), every permutation class other than the class of all permutations has a finite upper growth rate, meaning that the $n$th root of the number of permutations of length $n$ in the class has a finite limit superior. It has long been conjectured that this limit superior is in fact always a proper limit. We disprove this by constructing a permutation class whose upper and lower growth rates differ. The construction uses grid classes with cubic row-column graphs of increasing girth, obtained from Haar graphs of finite 2-groups. The corresponding hereditary property of ordered graphs also disproves an analogous 2006 conjecture of Balogh, Bollob\'as, and Morris. Along the way, we show that every proper permutation class with a D-finite generating function has a proper growth rate. We also establish refined enumerative bounds for grid classes, which lead to a short proof of Albert and Vatter's generalization of Bevan's Theorem on the growth rates of grid classes.
items.title_zh: 排列类别不需要有适当的增长率
items.excerpt_zh: 根据马库斯-塔多斯定理（以前的斯坦利-维尔夫猜想），除了所有排列的类之外的每个排列类都具有有限的上限增长率，这意味着该类中长度为 $n$ 的排列数量的 $n$th 根具有有限的优越极限。长期以来人们一直推测这个上极限实际上总是一个真极限。我们通过构建一个其上增长率和下增长率不同的排列类来反驳这一点。该构造使用具有周长递增的立方行列图的网格类，该网格类是从有限 2 组的 Haar 图获得的。有序图的相应遗传性质也反驳了 Balogh、Bollob'as 和 Morris 2006 年的类似猜想。在此过程中，我们证明了每个具有 D 有限生成函数的真排列类都具有适当的增长率。我们还为网格类建立了精确的枚举界限，这导致了阿尔伯特和瓦特对网格类增长率贝文定理的推广的简短证明。

items.title: Asymptotical results on the automorphism groups of canonical double cover of graphs
items.excerpt: The canonical double cover $BX$ of a graph $X$ is the direct product $X\times K_2$. A graph $X$ is stable if every automorphism of $BX$ is induced by automorphisms of $X$ and $K_2$, and unstable otherwise. We prove several asymptotic results on stable and unstable graphs. In particular, we show that the automorphism group of the canonical double cover of almost every graph has order $2$, and consequently that almost all graphs are stable. We also prove that the dominant sources of instability are having twins and being disconnected, in that order, and that graphs arising from a known construction are the next step in this hierarchy.
items.authors: Bart{\l}omiej Bychawski, Ademir Hujdurovi\'c, {\DJ}or{\dj}e Mitrovi\'c, Gabriel Verret
items.title_zh: 规范双覆盖图自同构群的渐近结果
items.excerpt_zh: 图 $X$ 的规范双重覆盖 $BX$ 是直积 $X\times K_2$。如果 $BX$ 的每个自同构都是由 $X$ 和 $K_2$ 自同构引发的，则图 $X$ 是稳定的，否则是不稳定的。我们在稳定和不稳定图上证明了几个渐近结果。特别是，我们证明几乎每个图的规范双重覆盖的自同构群都有 $2$ 阶，因此几乎所有图都是稳定的。我们还证明，不稳定的主要来源是按顺序生双胞胎和断开连接，并且由已知结构产生的图表是该层次结构中的下一步。

items.title: Denominators of Hodge integrals and Minkowski numbers
items.excerpt: We prove that the least common denominator of all genus $g$ Hodge integrals is the Minkowski number $T_{2g}$ or, equivalently, the Bhargava factorial $(2g+1)!_{\mathbb{P}}$ associated to the set of primes $\mathbb{P}\subset\mathbb{N}$. As a corollary, we prove a conjecture of Liu-Xu on the multiplicity of $3$ in the least common denominators of certain descendant integrals, and generalise their result on a conjecture of Itzykson-Zuber to Hodge integrals with $\lambda$ classes. Namely, the order of the automorphism group of any pointed stable curve of genus $g'\le g$ divides the least common denominator of all genus $g$ Hodge integrals. We also comment on the use of generative AI via IMProofBench, which played a fruitful part in the development of this (entirely human-written) paper.
items.title_zh: 霍奇积分和闵可夫斯基数的分母
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明所有$g$霍奇积分的最小公分母是明可夫斯基数$T_{2g}$，或者等效地，与素数集$\mathbb{P}\subset\mathbb{N}$相关的Bhargava阶乘$(2g+1)!_{\mathbb{P}}$。作为推论，我们证明了刘旭关于某些后代积分的最小公分母中 $3$ 重数的猜想，并将其结果推广到具有 $\lambda$ 类的 Itzykson-Zuber 猜想到 Hodge 积分上。即，亏格$g'\le g$的任意尖稳定曲线的自同构群的阶除以所有亏格$g$霍奇积分的最小公分母。我们还通过 IMProofBench 评论了生成式人工智能的使用，它在这篇（完全由人类编写的）论文的开发中发挥了富有成效的作用。

items.title: Relative Hitchin fibrations and endoscopy for Unitary Friedberg--Jacquet varieties
items.excerpt: We prove a relative fundamental lemma for the unitary symmetric variety $GL_n(k')\backslash U_{2n}$, proving a conjecture of Leslie, Xiao, and Zhang. Our proof reduces to the Lie algebra and argues over function fields in positive characteristic, using methods from Ngo-Laumon and Ngo. In particular, we reinterpret orbital integrals in terms of the cohomology of relative affine Springer fibers and globalize this using unitary versions of Hitchin moduli spaces for symmetric pairs via a product formula. As the main global input, we prove a matching of perverse sheaves between relative Hitchin moduli spaces and their corresponding endoscopic variants.
items.title_zh: 酉 Friedberg--Jacquet 变种的相对希钦纤维和内窥镜检查
items.excerpt_zh: 我们证明了酉对称簇$GL_n(k')\反斜杠U_{2n}$的相对基本引理，证明了Leslie、Xiao和Zhang的猜想。我们的证明简化为李代数，并使用 Ngo-Laumon 和 Ngo 的方法对正特征函数域进行论证。特别是，我们根据相对仿射施普林格纤维的上同调重新解释轨道积分，并通过乘积公式使用对称对的希钦模空间的酉版本将其全球化。作为主要的全局输入，我们证明了相对希钦模空间及其相应的内窥镜变体之间反常滑轮的匹配。

items.title: Asymptotics of local height pairing without Hodge conjecture
items.excerpt: We remove the assumption of the Hodge conjecture from the asymptotic formula for the Archimedean local height established in our previous work. We also remove other minor assumptions. We achieve this by exploiting the cohomological nature of Beilinson's local intersection index rather than arguing motivically.
items.title_zh: 无 Hodge 猜想的局部高度配对的渐近
items.excerpt_zh: 我们从我们之前的工作中建立的阿基米德局部高度的渐近公式中删除了霍奇猜想的假设。我们还删除了其他次要假设。我们通过利用 Beilinson 局部交集指数的上同调性质来实现这一点，而不是进行动机争论。

items.title: The dual complex and RC-invariant functors
items.excerpt: We extend the dual complex of a simple normal crossings divisor to a homotopy type invariant $\mathcal{D}(X)$ of arbitrary complex varieties, and we prove that it is contractible when $X$ is connected and of klt type. In fact, the dual complex belongs to a broader class of invariants, which we call RC (rationally connected)-invariant functors. We prove a rigidity theorem governing the behavior of such functors with respect to rationally connected fibrations.
items.title_zh: 对偶复数和 RC 不变函子
items.excerpt_zh: 我们将简单正规交叉除数的对偶复形扩展到任意复变体的同伦型不变量$\mathcal{D}(X)$，并证明当$X$连通且为klt类型时它是可收缩的。事实上，对偶复形属于更广泛的不变量类别，我们将其称为 RC（有理连接）不变量函子。我们证明了控制此类函子在有理连接的纤维方面的行为的刚性定理。

items.title: Obstructions to deforming space curves lying on a complete intersection of quadrics
items.excerpt: Let $S=S_{2,\ldots,2}\subset\mathbb P^{n+2}$ be a smooth complete intersection of $n$ quadrics containing a line $E$, where $n\geq 3$, and set $D=(n-1)\mathbf h+E$, where $\mathbf h=[\mathcal O_S(1)]$. We study the deformations of smooth curves $C\in |mD|$ and their obstructions. The linear system $|D|$ defines a birational morphism $f:S\to\overline S$ that contracts $E$ to a point and realizes an unprojection in the sense of Papadakis--Reid. When $n=3$, the surface $S=S_{2,2,2}\subset\mathbb P^5$ is a $K3$ surface and $E$ is a $(-2)$-curve. We prove that the complementary open surface $S\setminus E$ admits first-order infinitesimal deformations in $\mathbb P^5\setminus E$ that are obstructed at the second order. Using these obstructions, we show that, for every sufficiently large $m$ with $\operatorname{char} k\nmid m$, there exists a generically non-reduced irreducible component $W_m$ of the Hilbert scheme $\operatorname{Hilb}^{sc}\mathbb P^5$ of smooth connected curves in $\mathbb P^5$. items.title_zh: 位于二次曲面完全相交处的空间曲线变形的障碍
items.excerpt_zh: 令 $S=S_{2,\ldots,2}\subset\mathbb P^{n+2}$ 为包含线 $E$ 的 $n$ 二次曲线的平滑完全交集，其中 $n\geq 3$，并设置 $D=(n-1)\mathbf h+E$，其中 $\mathbf h=[\mathcal O_S(1)]$。我们研究平滑曲线 $C\in |mD|$ 的变形及其障碍。线性系统 $|D|$ 定义了一个双有理态射 $f:S\to\overline S$ ，它将 $E$ 收缩到一个点并实现 Papadakis--Reid 意义上的非投影。当$n=3$时，曲面$S=S_{2,2,2}\subset\mathbb P^5$是$K3$曲面，$E$是$(-2)$曲线。我们证明互补开曲面 $S\setminus E$ 允许 $\mathbb P^5\setminus E$ 中的一阶无穷小变形，而在二阶上受到阻碍。使用这些障碍，我们表明，对于每个足够大的 $m$ 和 $\operatorname{char} k\nmid m$，存在希尔伯特方案 $\operatorname{Hilb}^{sc}\mathbb P^5$ 的一般非约简不可约分量 $W_m$，其中 $\mathbb P^5$ 中的平滑连接曲线。它的一般成员$C$位于三个二次曲面的完全交集$S_{2,2,2}$上，满足$C\sim mD$，并且有$h^0(N_{C/\mathbb P^5})-\dim_{[

items.title: Uniformity of the minimal exponent on the GIT boundary of projective hypersurfaces
items.excerpt: Let $X$ be a non-stable (in the sense of GIT) hypersurface of degree $d \ge 3$ in the projective space $\mathbb{P}^{n}$. S. G. Park proved that the global minimal exponent of $X$ satisfies the inequality $\widetilde{\alpha}(X) \le \frac{n+1}{d}$. In this paper, we establish the uniform sharpness of this inequality: we prove that $\widetilde{\alpha}(X) = \frac{n+1}{d}$ holds for a general member $X$ of every irreducible component of the strictly semistable locus. Moreover, a general point of each irreducible component of the GIT boundary $\partial M^{\mathrm{GIT}}$ admits a strictly semistable zero-weight representative with this minimal exponent. By the lower semicontinuity of the minimal exponent on the affine cone and a theorem of Musta\c{t}\u{a}--Popa for general linear combinations of monomials, the problem is reduced to computing the log canonical thresholds, at the cone vertex, of the monomial ideals associated with the maximal strictly semistable supports with respect to a maximal torus and their weight-zero parts. Since the barycenter of the degree-$d$ simplex lies in the convex hull of each of these supports, Howald's formula
items.title_zh: 射影超曲面GIT边界上最小指数的均匀性
items.excerpt_zh: 令$X$ 为射影空间$\mathbb{P}^{n}$ 中$d \ge 3$ 度的非稳定（在GIT 意义上）超曲面。 S. G. Park证明$X$的全局最小指数满足不等式$\widetilde{\alpha}(X) \le \frac{n+1}{d}$。在本文中，我们建立了这个不等式的均匀锐度：我们证明 $\widetilde{\alpha}(X) = \frac{n+1}{d}$ 对于严格半稳定轨迹的每个不可约分量的一般成员 $X$ 成立。此外，GIT 边界 $\partial M^{\mathrm{GIT}}$ 的每个不可约分量的一般点都承认具有该最小指数的严格半稳定零权重表示。通过仿射锥上最小指数的下半连续性和单项式一般线性组合的 Musta\c{t}\u{a}--Popa 定理，问题被简化为计算与相对于最大环面及其权重零部分的最大严格半稳定支撑相关的单项式理想在圆锥顶点处的对数正则阈值。由于度 $d$ 单纯形的重心位于每个支撑的凸包内，霍华德公式

items.title: Third-Order Weierstrass Points on Plane Quartics
items.excerpt: For a smooth plane quartic $C$, the $3$-Weierstrass points are the $300$ points (counted with weights) at which some plane cubic has contact order at least ten with $C$. Revisiting the work of Kamel and Elshareef, we write the third Veronese Wronskian as an $\text{SL}_3$-covariant form $\Omega_3$ of degree $75$, given by a determinant of iterated Hamiltonian derivatives, and explain the special $3$-Weierstrass points through contact cubics and homologies preserving $C$. We determine $\Omega_3$ for the Fermat, Komiya--Kuribayashi, Klein and Picard quartics; for the Klein quartic $\Omega_3\equiv\Phi_6^2\,\Phi_{21}\,(3\Phi_{14}^3+21962\,\Phi_6^7)$ modulo the curve, up to a non-zero scalar. Finally, the dectactic points of the Fermat quartic are not $4$-Weierstrass points, which disproves a conjecture of Kamel and Elshareef. All computations are supported by \texttt{SINGULAR} scripts.
items.title_zh: 平面四次方程上的三阶 Weierstrass 点
items.excerpt_zh: 对于光滑平面四次 $C$，$3$-Weierstrass 点是 $300$ 点（按权重计算），在该点上，某个平面三次方与 $C$ 的接触阶至少为 10。回顾 Kamel 和 Elshareef 的工作，我们将第三个 Veronese Wronskian 写为 $\text{SL}_3$-协变形式 $\Omega_3$，次数为 $75$，由迭代哈密顿导数的行列式给出，并通过保留 $C$ 的接触三次和同调来解释特殊的 $3$-Weierstrass 点。我们确定 Fermat、Komiya--Kuribayashi、Klein 和 Picard 四次方程的 $\Omega_3$；对于克莱因四次曲线 $\Omega_3\equiv\Phi_6^2\,\Phi_{21}\,(3\Phi_{14}^3+21962\,\Phi_6^7)$ 对曲线取模，直至非零标量。最后，费马四次方程的十点不是 $4$-Weierstrass 点，这反驳了 Kamel 和 Elshareef 的猜想。所有计算均由 \texttt{SINGULAR} 脚本支持。

items.title: The classification of smooth 3-fold flops
items.excerpt: This paper establishes the analytic classification of smooth, simple, 3-fold flops, and in the process provides both an intrinsic characterisation and a classification of their contraction algebras.
items.title_zh: 平滑3次失败的分类
items.excerpt_zh: 本文建立了平滑、简单、三倍触发器的解析分类，并在此过程中提供了它们的收缩代数的内在表征和分类。

items.title: Generalized Images for Brownian First Passage to Monomial Boundaries
items.excerpt: We study the first passage of Brownian motion to a monomial moving boundary. For every integer degree at least two, we construct a time-independent signed image measure whose heat potential is the killed Brownian transition density on a nonzero interval of the natural Brownian time scale. The image density is determined by a second-kind Volterra equation in the image coordinate, not by the classical Volterra equations in time for the hitting density. Its kernel is an explicit Wright function, and the first-passage density is recovered afterwards from the boundary flux. Exponential bounds establish convergence, while a beta-moment transform connects the Wright kernel with the finite-order differential hierarchy previously obtained from transported moving zeros. A cubic numerical experiment independently checks the resulting density against simulated Brownian paths.
items.title_zh: 布朗首次通过单项式边界的广义图像
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究布朗运动到单项式移动边界的第一步。对于每个至少为二的整数度，我们构造一个与时间无关的符号图像测量，其热势是自然布朗时间尺度的非零间隔上的杀死布朗跃迁密度。图像密度由图像坐标中的第二类 Volterra 方程决定，而不是由击中密度时间上的经典 Volterra 方程决定。其核是一个显式赖特函数，并且随后从边界通量中恢复第一通道密度。指数界限建立收敛，而 beta 矩变换将赖特核与先前从传输的移动零获得的有限阶微分层次结构连接起来。三次数值实验根据模拟布朗路径独立检查所得密度。

items.title: A note on functional non-central limit theorem for periodic regime-switching stable-like processes
items.excerpt: In this paper, we establish a functional non-central limit theorem for regime-switching stable-like processes with periodic coefficients. Our approach relies on stochastic analysis methods, in particular semimartingale characteristics, combined with the ergodic theory of Markov processes. If the set on which the order function achieves its minimum value $\underline{\alpha}$ has positive Lebesgue measure, then the limit is a rotationally invariant $\underline{\alpha}$-stable L\'evy process. Otherwise, the limit is the zero process.
items.title_zh: 关于周期性状态切换类稳定过程的泛函非中心极限定理的注记
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们建立了具有周期系数的状态切换类稳定过程的函数非中心极限定理。我们的方法依赖于随机分析方法，特别是半鞅特征，并结合马尔可夫过程的遍历理论。如果阶函数达到最小值 $\underline{\alpha}$ 的集合具有正勒贝格测度，则极限是旋转不变的 $\underline{\alpha}$-稳定 L\'evy 过程。否则，极限就是零过程。

items.title: Optimal CLT error bounds in the second order Wasserstein metric via Stein's method for weakly dependent sequences
items.excerpt: We use Stein's method to prove general upper bounds on the second order Wasserstein distance in the CLT for general dependent partial sums $S_N=X_1+\ldots +X_N$. Then we use these estimates to provide optimal $O(N^{-1/2})$ rates for a variety of chaotic dynamical systems and $\phi$- and $\psi$-mixing sequences. Our results for $\psi$-mixing sequences are obtained under the fourth moment condition, which matches the best known results in the iid case. This is the first time that optimal CLT rates of any kind are obtained for unbounded weakly stationary variables under general mixing conditions. We then apply this result and obtain optimal CLT rates $O\left((\text{Var}(S_N))^{-1/2}\right)$ for non-stationary $\psi$-mixing sequences without any growth rates on $\text{Var}(S_N)$. We also obtain close to optimal CLT rates for nonconventional sums and some classes of random dynamical systems with non-uniform decay of correlations
items.title_zh: 通过弱依赖序列的 Stein 方法在二阶 Wasserstein 度量中实现最佳 CLT 误差范围
items.excerpt_zh: 我们使用 Stein 方法来证明 CLT 中一般相关部分和 $S_N=X_1+\ldots +X_N$ 的二阶 Wasserstein 距离的一般上限。然后，我们使用这些估计为各种混沌动力系统以及 $\phi$- 和 $\psi$- 混合序列提供最佳 $O(N^{-1/2})$ 速率。我们的 $\psi$ 混合序列结果是在四阶矩条件下获得的，这与独立同分布情况下最知名的结果相匹配。这是第一次在一般混合条件下针对无界弱平稳变量获得任何类型的最佳 CLT 率。然后，我们应用此结果并获得非平稳 $\psi$ 混合序列的最佳 CLT 率 $O\left((\text{Var}(S_N))^{-1/2}\right)$，而 $\text{Var}(S_N)$ 上没有任何增长率。我们还获得了非常规总和以及某些具有非均匀相关性衰减的随机动力系统类别的接近最佳 CLT 率

items.title: The longest increasing subsequences of Luce permutations and permutons
items.excerpt: We investigate the longest increasing subsequences (LIS) of random permutations distributed under the Luce model with weights $\theta_1^{(n)} \ge \ldots \ge \theta_n^{(n)}$. Our first main result provides a general formula for the growth rate of the LIS. For example, we get that the LIS of Luce permutations with Sukhatme weights $\theta_k^{(n)} = n-k+1$ grows like $\sqrt{n}$. We also give simple conditions for the LIS to be of order $n^\beta$, for any given $\beta\in[1/2,1)$. Our second main result states that, if the weights are of the form $\theta_k^{(n)} = f\big( (k-1)/n \big)$ for a sufficiently regular function $f$, then the LIS divided by $2\sqrt{n}$ converges in probability to a constant $K(f)$ described by a variational problem. Throughout, we make extensive use of coupling techniques; in particular, to prove our second main result, we argue that Luce random permutations behave similarly to random permutations sampled from the ``Luce permuton''.
items.title_zh: Luce 排列和排列的最长递增子序列
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究了权重为 $\theta_1^{(n)} \ge \ldots \ge \theta_n^{(n)}$ 的 Luce 模型下分布的随机排列的最长递增子序列 (LIS)。我们的第一个主要结果提供了 LIS 增长率的一般公式。例如，我们得到 Sukhatme 权重 $\theta_k^{(n)} = n-k+1$ 的 Luce 排列的 LIS 增长得像 $\sqrt{n}$。对于任何给定的 $\beta\in[1/2,1)$，我们还给出了 LIS 阶 $n^\beta$ 的简单条件。我们的第二个主要结果表明，如果对于足够规则的函数 $f$，权重的形式为 $\theta_k^{(n)} = f\big( (k-1)/n \big)$，那么 LIS 除以 $2\sqrt{n}$ 的概率会收敛到由变分问题描述的常数 $K(f)$。在整个过程中，我们广泛使用了耦合技术；特别是，为了证明我们的第二个主要结果，我们认为 Luce 随机排列的行为与从“Luce 排列”中采样的随机排列类似。

items.title: Couplings with prescribed maxima: A short proof of the quasi-copula characterization
items.excerpt: We provide a short probabilistic proof of the classical characterization of multivariate quasi-copulas, addressing the call for a simpler and more transparent proof expressed by Sempi (2017). Our approach is based on a coupling construction for random variables with fixed marginal distributions and a prescribed distribution of their maximum. In our main result, we show that such a coupling exists if and only if the maximum is stochastically no smaller than each component and the distribution of the maximum is dominated by the sum of the marginal measures. The construction applies to arbitrary distributions and relies only on a decomposition of the maximum law and monotone quantile couplings. A direct consequence of our main result is the existence of copulas with prescribed values along an increasing track.
items.title_zh: 具有规定最大值的耦合：准 Copula 表征的简短证明
items.excerpt_zh: 我们提供了多元准联结函数经典表征的简短概率证明，满足 Sempi (2017) 表达的对更简单、更透明证明的呼吁。我们的方法基于具有固定边际分布和规定的最大值分布的随机变量的耦合结构。在我们的主要结果中，我们表明，当且仅当最大值随机不小于每个分量并且最大值的分布由边际测量之和主导时，这种耦合才存在。该构造适用于任意分布，并且仅依赖于最大定律和单调分位数耦合的分解。我们的主要结果的直接结果是存在具有规定值的联结沿着递增的轨道。

items.title: The Laplace transform of the stationary measure of the open KPZ equation in the shock region
items.excerpt: The stationary increment measure of the open Kardar-Parisi-Zhang equation on a bounded interval can be represented as the independent sum of a Brownian motion and another process defined via an explicit Radon-Nikodym derivative with respect to the measure induced by a Brownian motion. In the fan region, its finite-dimensional Laplace transform was previously expressed in terms of the continuous dual Hahn process. The main contribution here consists of computing the finite-dimensional Laplace transform for a range of parameters in the shock region by an analytic continuation argument. As an application, we provide a direct proof of the convergence of the finite-dimensional distributions of the increment height function of open WASEP under the stationary measure in the shock region, by computing the convergence of finite-dimensional Laplace transform without relating to the open KPZ equation.
items.title_zh: 激波区开KPZ方程平稳测度的拉普拉斯变换
items.excerpt_zh: 有界区间上开式 Kardar-Parisi-Zhang 方程的平稳增量测度可以表示为布朗运动与通过显式 Radon-Nikodym 导数相对于布朗运动引起的测度定义的另一个过程的独立和。在扇形区域中，其有限维拉普拉斯变换以前用连续对偶哈恩过程来表示。这里的主要贡献包括通过解析延拓参数计算冲击区域中一系列参数的有限维拉普拉斯变换。作为一个应用，我们通过计算有限维拉普拉斯变换的收敛性，而不涉及开式 KPZ 方程，直接证明了在冲击区域的稳态测度下开式 WASEP 增量高度函数的有限维分布的收敛性。

items.title: Stationary Half-space Geometric Last Passage Percolation without Random Shift
items.excerpt: We derive exact formulas for the diagonal distribution of half-space geometric last-passage percolation with a two-parameter family of stationary initial conditions throughout the phase diagram. Unlike previous results, our formulas remove the random shift at the origin. Under critical scaling, we obtain new formulas for the half-space stationary KPZ fixed-point distribution at $x=0$ in the high-density and maximal-current phases. In the low-density phase, we derive a new representation and show that it matches the corresponding formula from the stationary log-gamma polymer.
items.title_zh: 无随机位移的静止半空间几何最后通道渗滤
items.excerpt_zh: 我们推导出半空间几何最后通道渗透的对角分布的精确公式，在整个相图中具有固定初始条件的两参数族。与之前的结果不同，我们的公式消除了原点处的随机偏移。在临界缩放下，我们获得了高密度和最大电流阶段 $x=0$ 处半空间平稳 KPZ 定点分布的新公式。在低密度相中，我们推导了一种新的表示形式，并表明它与固定对数伽马聚合物的相应公式相匹配。

items.title: Central limit theorem for the Smoluchowski--Kramers approximation
items.excerpt: We establish the central limit theorem (CLT) for Smoluchowski--Kramers approximation of Langevin equations with state-dependent, possibly non-symmetric friction and multiplicative noise. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first such result, even in the case of constant friction and additive noise. The result differs in an essential way from classical averaging CLTs and reveals a new two-scale fluctuation phenomenon. The normalized difference process retains a persistent fast component and is generally not tight in $C([0,T];\mathbb{R}^d)$, thus the usual continuous-path CLT cannot hold. We derive an exact decomposition of the normalized difference into an accumulated slow fluctuation and a rapidly relaxing velocity correction. The auxiliary slow fluctuation converges to a linear diffusion driven by both the original Brownian motion and an additional independent Brownian noise whose effective covariance is characterized explicitly through a quadratic Poisson corrector. For every fixed $t>0$, the fast correction converges conditionally to its local Gaussian equilibrium. Consequently, the fixed-time fluctuation limit is identified
items.authors: Yun Li, Longjie Xie, Li Yang, Qianning Zhang
items.title_zh: Smoluchowski--Kramers 近似的中心极限定理
items.excerpt_zh: 我们为具有状态相关、可能非对称摩擦和乘性噪声的 Langevin 方程的 Smoluchowski-Kramers 近似建立了中心极限定理 (CLT)。据我们所知，这是第一个这样的结果，即使是在恒定摩擦和附加噪声的情况下也是如此。该结果与经典平均 CLT 有本质区别，并揭示了一种新的两尺度波动现象。归一化差分过程保留了持久的快速分量，并且在 $C([0,T];\mathbb{R}^d)$ 中通常不紧，因此通常的连续路径 CLT 无法成立。我们将归一化差异精确分解为累积的缓慢波动和快速松弛的速度校正。辅助慢波动收敛为由原始布朗运动和附加独立布朗噪声驱动的线性扩散，其有效协方差通过二次泊松校正器明确表征。对于每个固定的$t>0$，快速修正有条件地收敛到其局部高斯均衡。因此，确定了固定时间波动限制

items.title: Triple Products of Correlated Multivariate Hermite Polynomials
items.excerpt: Stochastic Galerkin schemes (SGS) are used to approximate solutions to differential equations with stochastic parameters. In particular, they express the solution with an infinite orthogonal functional basis of the parameter space and derive a deterministic system of PDEs; the solution of this deterministic system can be used to produce a {surrogate} approximation of the original stochastic equations. When the parameters are correlated, the infinite series representation of the solution does not provably converge for all joint distributions; further, classic decorrelating transformations (e.g., Roseblatt) often introduce known numerical instabilities. Rahman (2017) established convergence in probability and distribution for correlated {Gaussian} parameters when the basis functionals are {multivariate Hermite polynomials} (MHPs), where these polynomials are only {weakly orthogonal} with respect to the underlying joint density. Due to weak orthogonality, the $N$th moments of MHPs introduced during Galerkin projection do not trivially decompose into products of one-dimensional expectations and have no closed-form expression for $N > 2$;
items.title_zh: 相关多元Hermite多项式的三重积
items.excerpt_zh: 随机伽辽金方案 (SGS) 用于近似具有随机参数的微分方程的解。特别是，他们用参数空间的无限正交函数基来表达解，并导出偏微分方程的确定性系统；该确定性系统的解可用于产生原始随机方程的{代理}近似。当参数相关时，解的无限级数表示不能证明对于所有联合分布都收敛；此外，经典的去相关变换（例如 Roseblatt）通常会引入已知的数值不稳定性。 Rahman (2017) 当基函数是{多元 Hermite 多项式} (MHP) 时，建立了相关 {高斯} 参数的概率和分布的收敛性，其中这些多项式相对于底层联合密度仅是{弱正交}。由于正交性较弱，伽辽金投影期间引入的 MHP 的第 $N$ 矩不会轻易分解为一维期望的乘积，并且对于 $N > 2$ 没有闭合形式表达式；

items.title: Relaxation and $\Gamma$-Convergence of Stretch Energy on Surface Homeomorphisms
items.excerpt: Area-preserving parameterization of triangular meshes is an essential task in geometry processing, yet an exactly area-preserving simplicial mapping may not exist in general. In this paper, we study area preservation of simplicial mappings in the limit of mesh refinement by establishing the $\Gamma$-convergence of the discrete stretch energy, a functional that measures their area distortion. We first introduce its limit functional, the relaxed stretch energy on surface homeomorphisms, defined through the pushforward of the area measure, and show that it is the relaxation of the stretch energy of diffeomorphisms with respect to uniform convergence. Then, to compare simplicial mappings with homeomorphisms, we construct a geometric lift that requires no shape-regularity assumption on the image mesh. Finally, we establish the $\Gamma$-convergence and show that the minimal discrete energies converge to the continuum minimum. Moreover, any homeomorphism arising as a limit of lifted discrete local minimizers in fixed-radius balls is area-preserving.
items.title_zh: 表面同胚上拉伸能的弛豫和$\Gamma$-收敛
items.excerpt_zh: 三角网格的面积保留参数化是几何处理中的一项重要任务，但通常可能不存在精确保留面积的单纯映射。在本文中，我们通过建立离散拉伸能量的 $\Gamma$ 收敛（一种测量其面积扭曲的函数）来研究网格细化极限下单纯映射的面积保留。我们首先介绍了它的极限泛函，即表面同胚上的松弛拉伸能，通过面积测度的前推来定义，并证明它是微分同胚的拉伸能相对于一致收敛的松弛。然后，为了比较单纯映射与同胚，我们构造了一个不需要图像网格上的形状规则性假设的几何提升。最后，我们建立 $\Gamma$ 收敛并表明最小离散能量收敛到连续谱最小值。此外，作为固定半径球中提升的离散局部最小化器的极限而产生的任何同胚都是面积保持的。

items.title: DBDSVDMR3: An MRRR-Based Bidiagonal SVD Solver Built from DSTEGR
items.excerpt: The optimal algorithm for the symmetric tridiagonal eigenvalue problem is Multiple Relatively Robust Representations (MRRR or MR$^3$), which is capable of computing $k$ eigenvalue/eigenvector pairs in only $O(kn)$ floating-point operations. While MRRR is nearly 30 years old, it has never successfully been adapted to the bidiagonal SVD. This is not for lack of trying; two previous attempts produced implementations that were considered for LAPACK but eventually abandoned, a result of the fact that neither was reliable enough when run on test problems. The question therefore remained: is there a problem with the theory of MRRR for the bidiagonal SVD or were there simply bugs in the previous implementations that went undetected? This paper resolves this question by presenting DBDSVDMR3 -- a new implementation of the MRRR-based algorithm for the bidiagonal SVD originally proposed by Willems and Lang [ETNA 2012], which, for the first time, performs well on a variety of test problems while achieving significant speedups over both LAPACK's bisection-based solver and, in certain cases, divide-and-conquer for the bidiagonal SVD (thereby indicat
items.authors: James Demmel, Inderjit Dhillon, Sai Surya Duvvuri, Julien Langou, Osni Marques, Ryan Schneider
items.title_zh: DBDSVDMR3：基于 DSTEGR 构建的基于 MRRR 的双对角 SVD 求解器
items.excerpt_zh: 对称三对角特征值问题的最佳算法是多重相对鲁棒表示（MRRR 或 MR$^3$），它能够仅以 $O(kn)$ 浮点运算计算 $k$ 特征值/特征向量对。虽然 MRRR 已有近 30 年的历史，但它从未成功地适应双对角 SVD。这并不是因为缺乏尝试；而是因为。之前的两次尝试产生了曾考虑用于 LAPACK 的实现，但最终被放弃，因为在测试问题上运行时两者都不够可靠。因此，问题依然存在：双对角 SVD 的 MRRR 理论是否存在问题，或者之前的实现中是否存在未被检测到的错误？本文通过提出 DBDSVDMR3 来解决这个问题——一种基于 MRRR 的双对角 SVD 算法的新实现，最初由 Willems 和 Lang [ETNA 2012] 提出，该算法首次在各种测试问题上表现良好，同时比 LAPACK 基于二分的求解器实现显着加速，并且在某些情况下，对双对角 SVD 进行分而治之（从而表明

items.title: Summation-by-parts operators for general function spaces: Flux differencing, entropy stability, and accuracy
items.excerpt: Summation-by-parts (SBP) operators are a cornerstone of provably stable high-order methods for hyperbolic conservation laws. For nonlinear problems, the flux-differencing framework of Fisher and Carpenter combines such SBP operators with entropy-conservative two-point fluxes to obtain semi-discretizations that are conservative in the sense of Lax--Wendroff and discretely entropy-conservative or stable. So far, this framework has been developed exclusively for operators that are exact for polynomials. Function-space SBP (FSBP) operators lift this restriction by being exact on a general finite-dimensional function space that can be tailored to the problem at hand. In this work, we extend flux differencing to FSBP operators for general (potentially non-polynomial) function spaces. We prove that, whenever the operator has a diagonal norm and its function space contains the constants, the resulting semi-discretization is conservative in the sense of Lax--Wendroff, semi-discretely entropy-conservative within a single element, and entropy-stable across element interfaces. We also provide the first theoretical accuracy analysis of FSBP operat
items.authors: Henry M. Haase, Andrew R. Winters, Jan Glaubitz
items.title_zh: 一般函数空间的分部求和运算符：通量微分、熵稳定性和准确性
items.excerpt_zh: 分部求和 (SBP) 算子是可证明稳定的双曲守恒定律高阶方法的基石。对于非线性问题，Fisher 和 Carpenter 的通量微分框架将此类 SBP 算子与熵保守的两点通量相结合，以获得 Lax-Wendroff 意义上保守的半离散化和离散熵保守或稳定的半离散化。到目前为止，这个框架是专门为多项式精确算子开发的。函数空间 SBP (FSBP) 算子通过在可针对当前问题进行定制的通用有限维函数空间上精确化来解除此限制。在这项工作中，我们将通量差分扩展到一般（可能非多项式）函数空间的 FSBP 算子。我们证明，只要算子具有对角范数并且其函数空间包含常量，所得到的半离散化在 Lax-Wendroff 意义上是保守的，在单个元素内是半离散熵保守的，并且在元素界面上是熵稳定的。我们还首次提供了 FSBP 操作的理论精度分析

items.title: Structure-Preserving Dimension Reduction and Surrogates for Partially Linear Bayesian Inverse Problems
items.excerpt: Many Bayesian inverse problems are characterized by two parameter vectors with distinct roles. A medium property, operator coefficient, or geometry block enters the forward model nonlinearly, whereas a volumetric, initial condition, or boundary condition source enters linearly. General-purpose nonlinear surrogates must relearn this known source dependence from data and may not preserve the correct source scaling outside the training regime. We introduce a structure-preserving partially linear (SPPL) framework that constructs separate reduced spaces for outputs, (linearly appearing) sources, and (nonlinearly appearing) medium variables and represents the reduced forward map as an affine function of the retained source coordinates, with coefficients that depend on the medium variables. Here, "affine" refers to the retained, mean-centered source coordinates: the physical forward map remains linear in the source, while the affine offset is induced by the source-prior mean and vanishes when that mean is zero. The analysis first identifies the optimal blockwise ridge approximation and then derives the optimal affine-in-source approximation
items.authors: Ziheng Zhang, Dingcheng Luo, Thomas O'Leary-Roseberry, Umberto Villa, Omar Ghattas
items.title_zh: 部分线性贝叶斯逆问题的结构保持降维和代理
items.excerpt_zh: 许多贝叶斯逆问题的特征是具有不同作用的两个参数向量。介质属性、算子系数或几何块以非线性方式进入正演模型，而体积源、初始条件或边界条件源以线性方式进入。通用非线性代理必须从数据中重新学习这种已知的源依赖性，并且可能无法在训练体系之外保留正确的源缩放。我们引入了一种结构保持部分线性（SPPL）框架，该框架为输出、（线性出现）源和（非线性出现）介质变量构造单独的缩减空间，并将缩减前向映射表示为保留源坐标的仿射函数，其系数取决于介质变量。这里，“仿射”指的是保留的、以均值为中心的源坐标：物理前向映射在源中保持线性，而仿射偏移由源先验均值引起，并在该均值为零时消失。该分析首先确定最佳的分块岭近似，然后导出最佳的源内仿射近似

items.title: Matrix-Free Local Multigrid for $C^1$ Hermite Discretizations on GPUs
items.excerpt: I present a matrix-free local multigrid method for $C^1$ tensor-product Hermite discretizations on adaptively refined Cartesian meshes, using the clamped biharmonic problem as the model problem. Extending a cell-wise primal-dual formulation to Hermite elements, I enforce continuity through a constraint operator that is never formed. At refinement edges, geometric prolongation supplies both the trace and its normal derivative, so the local V-cycle needs no edge operator and no hanging-node machinery. For the cubic element, an even-odd decomposition based on the signed reflection symmetry of the Hermite basis, applied along two axes, splits the element matrix into four dense $16\times16$ blocks and reaches 85% of peak memory bandwidth. Chebyshev-Jacobi and vertex-patch smoothers both preserve conformity by construction. In three dimensions on one NVIDIA A100 in double precision, conjugate gradients preconditioned by the Chebyshev-Jacobi V-cycle need five or six iterations on uniform meshes and solve at up to 4.23 million cells per second. On locally refined meshes the count rises to at most sixteen, ordered by the fraction of cells on a
items.title_zh: GPU 上 $C^1$ Hermite 离散化的无矩阵局部多重网格
items.excerpt_zh: 我提出了一种无矩阵局部多重网格方法，用于自适应细化笛卡尔网格上的 $C^1$ 张量积 Hermite 离散化，使用钳位双调和问题作为模型问题。将单元格原对偶公式扩展到 Hermite 元素，我通过从未形成的约束算子强制连续性。在细化边缘处，几何延展提供轨迹及其法向导数，因此局部 V 循环不需要边缘算子，也不需要悬挂节点机制。对于立方元素，基于 Hermite 基的有符号反射对称性的偶奇分解，沿两个轴应用，将元素矩阵分割为四个密集的 $16\times16$ 块，并达到峰值内存带宽的 85%。切比雪夫-雅可比和顶点补丁平滑器都通过构造保持一致性。在双精度 NVIDIA A100 的三维空间中，由 Chebyshev-Jacobi V 循环预处理的共轭梯度需要在均匀网格上进行五到六次迭代，并以每秒高达 423 万个单元的速度求解。在局部细化的网格上，计数最多增加到 16，按网格上的单元分数排序。

items.title: A unified variational framework for augmented Lagrangian preconditioning of saddle point systems: applications to mixed-dimensional and fictitious domain methods
items.excerpt: We present a general framework to derive augmented Lagrangian preconditioners for saddle point systems arising from mixed finite element discretizations. Our approach is based on augmenting the variational formulation at the continuous level prior to discretization, providing a unified strategy for designing efficient preconditioners that are robust under mesh refinement for a broad class of problems leading to symmetric saddle point systems. The robustness of the proposed preconditioners is established through a detailed spectral analysis. This framework is applied to different model problems, focusing on mixed-dimensional and fictitious domain formulations involving Lagrange multipliers, with some configurations featuring large coefficient jumps. Extensive numerical experiments on different test cases and geometries are presented, validating the effectiveness and robustness of our preconditioners when used in conjunction with flexible GMRES.
items.authors: Michele Benzi, Marco Feder, Luca Heltai, Federica Mugnaioni
items.title_zh: 鞍点系统增强拉格朗日预处理的统一变分框架：在混合维和虚拟域方法中的应用
items.excerpt_zh: 我们提出了一个通用框架，用于导出混合有限元离散化鞍点系统的增强拉格朗日预处理器。我们的方法基于在离散化之前在连续水平上增强变分公式，为设计有效的预处理器提供了统一的策略，这些预处理器在网格细化下对于导致对称鞍点系统的广泛问题具有鲁棒性。所提出的预处理器的鲁棒性是通过详细的频谱分析确定的。该框架适用于不同的模型问题，重点关注涉及拉格朗日乘子的混合维和虚拟域公式，以及一些具有大系数跳跃的配置。对不同测试用例和几何形状进行了广泛的数值实验，验证了我们的预处理器与灵活的 GMRES 结合使用时的有效性和鲁棒性。

items.title: Robust topology optimization of isogeometric Kirchhoff--Love shells by the Speed Method
items.excerpt: This paper presents a framework for robust topology optimization of Kirchhoff-Love (KL) multi-patch shells using isogeometric analysis and non-matching meshes and provides a CAD-compatible method. The material distribution is optimized via a NURBS-based level set method, enabling accurate boundary representation and seamless export to standard CAD/CAM workflows. The shape derivative is computed using the speed method, yielding a volume-based formulation that avoids boundary approximations and aligns with the isogeometric principle of coarse, high-order discretizations. This eliminates the need for local refinement, adaptive quadrature, or trimming as the descent direction for the compliance and volume objectives are obtained through a biharmonic equation. The framework is extended to robust optimization under uncertainty, accounting for stochastic loading and material properties via Monte Carlo sampling and Gaussian Random Fields. Numerical examples demonstrate the method's efficiency and robustness across single- and multi-patch shells, reproducing literature results with fewer elements than traditional FEM or refined IGA approaches.
items.authors: Philipp Eisenhardt, Fernando H\"ubner Scherer, Barbara Wohlmuth, Andrei Constantinescu
items.title_zh: 等几何Kirchhoff--Love壳的速度法鲁棒拓扑优化
items.excerpt_zh: 本文提出了一个使用等几何分析和非匹配网格对 Kirchhoff-Love (KL) 多面片壳进行鲁棒拓扑优化的框架，并提供了一种与 CAD 兼容的方法。材料分布通过基于 NURBS 的水平集方法进行优化，从而实现精确的边界表示并无缝导出到标准 CAD/CAM 工作流程。使用速度法计算形状导数，产生基于体积的公式，避免边界近似并符合粗略、高阶离散化的等几何原理。这消除了局部细化、自适应正交或修整的需要，因为柔量和体积目标的下降方向是通过双调和方程获得的。该框架扩展到不确定性下的鲁棒优化，通过蒙特卡罗采样和高斯随机场考虑随机载荷和材料属性。数值示例证明了该方法在单面片和多面片壳中的效率和鲁棒性，与传统 FEM 或改进的 IGA 方法相比，用更少的元素再现了文献结果。

items.title: Reflections on Trusting Lean
items.excerpt: It is known, by works of Werner and Carneiro, that the type theory of Lean (and indeed of CIC plus a version of choice) is equiconsistent with ZFC plus "there are infinitely many strongly inaccessible cardinals". We prove a finer connection between these two formal systems; namely, given any formula in the language of second order arithmetic, that formula is provable in the aforementioned extension of ZFC if and only if the same formula, when viewed as a type in Lean, is inhabited.
items.title_zh: 对信任精益的思考
items.excerpt_zh: 根据 Werner 和 Carneiro 的著作，我们知道精益的类型论（实际上是 CIC 加上选择的版本）与 ZFC 加上“有无限多个强不可接近的基数”是一致的。我们证明了这两个形式系统之间存在更精细的联系；也就是说，给定二阶算术语言中的任何公式，当且仅当将相同的公式视为 Lean 中的类型时，该公式在上述 ZFC 扩展中是可证明的。

items.title: A Study in Solution Models for SAT using the PBNF-transform
items.excerpt: In this article, we use the PBNF-transform, or Polynomial Boolean Normal Form, described earlier in two articles and now extended to higher arity, to solve Boolean satisfiability problems (SAT), which are part of the P versus NP problem. SAT consists of a statement of conjunctions of clauses, and in our SAT-solving models, we dualize the logical equations, inverting the problem by \emph{multiplying} letters (literals) in the transferred clauses, now phrases: $pqrs\cdots s_{\ell}$, and using a binary iterated composition based on \emph{adding polynomials} for the conjunctions in our solution formula. We obtain Polynomial Boolean Equations, PBE=0, by also renaming the truth value $1\mapsto 0$(T). To find a solution, we look for repeating literals in the clauses to factor out. With reversed literal repetition, we can even reduce the CNF to the sum of the transformed clauses.
items.title_zh: 使用 PBNF 变换的 SAT 解决方案模型研究
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们使用 PBNF 变换或多项式布尔范式（多项式布尔范式）来解决布尔可满足性问题 (SAT)，该变换是 P 与 NP 问题的一部分，该变换在前面的两篇文章中进行了描述，现在已扩展到更高的数量。 SAT 由子句的连词陈述组成，在我们的 SAT 求解模型中，我们对逻辑方程进行对偶化，通过在转移的子句中乘以 \emph{} 字母（文字）（现在是短语：$pqrs\cdots s_{\ell}$）来反转问题，并使用基于 \emph{添加多项式} 的二进制迭代组合作为我们解决方案公式中的连词。我们通过将真值 $1\maps 重命名为 0$(T) 来获得多项式布尔方程，PBE=0。为了找到解决方案，我们在子句中寻找重复的文字来分解。通过反向文字重复，我们甚至可以将 CNF 简化为转换子句的总和。

items.title: Computable presentations of separable Lebesgue spaces
items.excerpt: For every right-c.e.\ real $p\in(1,2)$, $L^p[0,1]$ has a computable presentation. The proof combines an effective stability modulus for almost isometric embeddings with a Fra\"{\i}ss\'e-style construction in which the exponent varies. In the same range, if $\ell^p$ has a computable presentation, then $p$ is computable. Combining these with the known results gives the computable presentability classification for all separable Lebesgue spaces. We also formulate an effective Fra\"{\i}ss\'e theorem for Banach spaces and apply it to obtain a computable presentation of the Gurarij Banach space.
items.title_zh: 可分离勒贝格空间的可计算表示
items.excerpt_zh: 对于每个右 c.e.\ real $p\in(1,2)$，$L^p[0,1]$ 都有一个可计算的表示。该证明将几乎等距嵌入的有效稳定性模量与指数变化的 Fra\"{\i}ss\'e 式构造相结合。在相同范围内，如果 $\ell^p$ 具有可计算表示，则 $p$ 是可计算的。将这些与已知结果相结合，给出所有可分离勒贝格空间的可计算表示性分类。我们还制定了有效的 Fra\"{\i}ss\'e Banach 空间定理，并应用它来获得 Gurarij Banach 空间的可计算表示。

items.title: Non-aware computable presentations of randomizations
items.excerpt: Let 2 be the two-element structure in the empty signature. We build a computable presentation Q of the Borel randomization $2^{[0,1)}$ in which neither constant random variable is a computable point. Consequently, Q is not aware. This gives a negative answer to a question of Cuervo Ovalle and Goldbring \cite{CG}. We also construct a countable structure $M$ with no computable presentation but $M^{[0,1)}$ has a computable presentation. This answers another question and establishes the necessity of the awareness condition stated in one of the main theorems in \cite{CG}.
items.title_zh: 随机化的无意识可计算呈现
items.excerpt_zh: 令 2 为空签名中的二元素结构。我们构建了 Borel 随机化 $2^{[0,1)}$ 的可计算表示 Q，其中常数随机变量都不是可计算点。因此，Q 并不知道。这对 Cuervo Ovalle 和 Goldbring \cite{CG} 的问题给出了否定的答案。我们还构造了一个可数结构 $M$ ，没有可计算的表示，但 $M^{[0,1)}$ 有可计算的表示。这回答了另一个问题，并建立了 \cite{CG} 中的一个主要定理中所述的意识条件的必要性。

items.title: Analytification and tropicalization via hyperfields and definable types
items.excerpt: We study the analytification and tropicalization of algebraic varieties over valued fields via Jun's spaces of hyperfield points. Our main new objects are a family of power-tropical hyperfields $H_n$ and their inverse limit $H$, recording at each level the class of a leading term modulo $n$-th powers of the residue field. They yield an enhanced tropicalization of the associated space $X(H)$, strictly finer than the Berkovich one exactly when the multiplicative group of the residue field is non-divisible: it specialises to the Berkovich analytification when the residue field is algebraically closed, to the real analytification of Jell-Scheiderer-Yu when it is real closed, and to a new $p$-adic analytification when it is $p$-adically closed. Over henselian valued fields of equicharacteristic $0$ we then construct a model-theoretic avatar of $X(H)$: the space $\widehat{X}_T$ of definable types orthogonal to the value group, which sharpens the geometry in the spirit of Hrushovski and Loeser and recovers their space over algebraically closed valued fields. We show that $\widehat{X}_T$ is strictly pro-definable, satisfies a model-theoretic
items.authors: Pablo Cubides Kovacsics, Mariana Vicar\'ia, Jinhe Ye
items.title_zh: 通过超场和可定义类型进行分析和热带化
items.excerpt_zh: 我们通过Jun的超场点空间研究了有价值域上的代数簇的分析和热带化。我们的主要新对象是一系列幂热带超场 $H_n$ 及其逆极限 $H$，在每个级别记录剩余场的首项模 $n$ 次方的类别。它们产生关联空间 $X(H)$ 的增强热带化，当留数域的乘法群不可整时，它比 Berkovich 空间更精细：当留数域代数闭时，它专门用于 Berkovich 分析；当 Jell-Scheiderer-Yu 实闭时，它专门用于 Jell-Scheiderer-Yu 的实分析；当它是 $p$-adic 时，它专门用于新的 $p$-adic 分析。关闭。然后，在等特征 $0$ 的汉森值域上，我们构建了 $X(H)$ 的模型理论化身：与值组正交的可定义类型的空间 $\widehat{X}_T$，这按照 Hrushovski 和 Loeser 的精神锐化了几何形状，并在代数闭值域上恢复了它们的空间。我们证明 $\widehat{X}_T$ 是严格可定义的，满足模型理论

items.title: Set-theoretic inevitability
items.excerpt: After defining the concept of inevitability for statements with the modal logic of forcing, we raise the question of which statements are inevitable under $\mathsf{ZFC}$ and under large cardinal hypotheses. We show that $\mathsf{SOA}$ (defined as $\mathsf{ZFC}^-$ + $\mathsf V=\mathsf{HC}$) plus the $\boldsymbol\Sigma^1_2$-perfect set property is $\mathsf{ZFC}$-inevitable, and that Projective Determinacy is inevitable in the theory of $\mathsf{ZFC}$ with a proper class of Woodin cardinals. We then discuss the possible conceptual significance of these results for the foundations of set theory.
items.title_zh: 集合论必然性
items.excerpt_zh: 在用强制的模态逻辑定义了陈述的必然性概念之后，我们提出了在 $\mathsf{ZFC}$ 和大基数假设下哪些陈述是不可避免的问题。我们证明$\mathsf{SOA}$（定义为$\mathsf{ZFC}^-$ + $\mathsf V=\mathsf{HC}$）加上$\boldsymbol\Sigma^1_2$-完美集合属性是$\mathsf{ZFC}$-不可避免的，并且在$\mathsf{ZFC}$理论中射影决定性是不可避免的，具有合适的伍丁类红衣主教。然后我们讨论这些结果对于集合论基础可能的概念意义。

items.title: There is no universal $F_\sigma$ equivalence relation
items.excerpt: Rosendal proved that any $K_\sigma$ equivalence relation is Borel reducible to $\ell_\infty$. We prove that for every $F_\sigma$ equivalence relation $F$ on a Polish space, there is an $F_\sigma$ real linear subspace $H$ of $\ell_2$ such that the coset relation $x\mathrel{E_H}y$ if and only if $x-y\in H$ has no Baire-measurable reduction to $F$. In particular, there is no $F_\sigma$ equivalence relation universal under Borel reducibility for all $F_\sigma$ equivalence relations. This answers a question of Rosendal.
items.title_zh: 不存在通用的$F_\sigma$等价关系
items.excerpt_zh: Rosendal 证明任何 $K_\sigma$ 等价关系都是 Borel 可简化为 $\ell_\infty$。我们证明，对于波兰空间上的每个 $F_\sigma$ 等价关系 $F$，存在 $\ell_2$ 的 $F_\sigma$ 实线性子空间 $H$，使得陪集关系 $x\mathrel{E_H}y$ 当且仅当 $x-y\in H$ 没有 Baire 可测量的减少到 $F$。特别是，对于所有 $F_\sigma$ 等价关系，在 Borel 可约性下不存在通用的 $F_\sigma$ 等价关系。这回答了罗森达尔的问题。

items.title: Groups satisfying the minimal condition on centralizers are complete co-analytic
items.excerpt: In this paper, we prove that the set of groups satisfying the minimal condition on centralizers is a complete co-analytic subset of the Polish space of countable groups. This answers a question of Wesolek and Williams.
items.title_zh: 满足扶正器最小条件的群是完全协分析的
items.excerpt_zh: 在本文中，我们证明满足集中器最小条件的群的集合是可数群的波兰空间的完全协分析子集。这回答了韦索莱克和威廉姆斯的问题。

items.title: When Stable and Preferred Semantics Agree: A Path-Based Approach
items.excerpt: We investigate structural conditions under which preferred and stable semantics agree in abstract argumentation frameworks. Our approach is based on suitably chosen sets of paths in the attack graph and binary relations induced by them. We establish a general path-based criterion for semantic agreement and instantiate it with several classes of paths, obtaining sufficient conditions expressed in terms of well-foundedness of the corresponding relations. The resulting conditions strictly generalize two principal structural criteria for preferred and stable agreement in the literature: Dung's limited controversiality condition and the SCC-symmetry condition. In particular, Dung's result is recovered as a special case by taking the relevant path set to be the set of even paths. We further introduce two infinite sequences of path sets, each yielding a family of agreement conditions. For the first sequence, a Collapse Theorem reduces the infinitely many associated well-foundedness conditions to three essentially distinct ones, whereas the second sequence gives rise to genuinely distinct conditions with no analogous collapse. items.title_zh: 当稳定和首选语义一致时：基于路径的方法
items.excerpt_zh: 我们研究了在抽象论证框架中首选和稳定的语义一致的结构条件。我们的方法基于攻击图中适当选择的路径集以及它们引起的二元关系。我们建立了一个通用的基于路径的语义一致性标准，并用几类路径实例化它，获得以对应关系的有根据性表示的充分条件。由此产生的条件严格概括了文献中首选和稳定协议的两个主要结构标准：Dung 的有限争议条件和 SCC 对称条件。特别地，通过将​​相关路径集合作为偶数路径的集合，将Dung的结果恢复为特例。我们进一步引入两个无限序列的路径集，每个序列产生一系列一致条件。对于第一个序列，崩溃定理将无限多个相关的有根据的条件减少为三个本质上不同的条件，而第二个序列产生了真正不同的条件，没有类似的崩溃。我们的结果应用程序

items.title: Breaking the high-degree barrier in Lehmer's problem with a human-AI discovery loop
items.excerpt: While artificial intelligence has made rapid progress in mathematical reasoning, many open problems depend on structure that is revealed only through large-scale computational exploration and analytical synthesis. One such example is Lehmer's problem from 1933. It asks whether the Mahler measure of an integer polynomial, which measures how far its roots stray from the unit circle, can be made arbitrarily small. Previously, constructing irreducible polynomials with integer coefficients and small Mahler measure has been carried out systematically only for even degrees $d \le 180$. At higher degrees, Boyd's analytical one-parameter family frequently factors, skipping nearly 50% of target degrees and leaving no general construction for arbitrary $d$. Here, we address the high-degree regime through a human-AI discovery loop, in which we extend the conversational prompting with a fast numerical pipeline, an exact symbolic verifier, and large-scale distributed search. The AI agent prototypes numerical and symbolic solvers locally, launches parallel searches across distributed clusters and works with the human researcher to extract and verify
items.authors: Yuri Chervonyi, Sergei Gukov, Thang Luong
items.title_zh: 通过人类-人工智能发现循环打破莱默问题的高度障碍
items.excerpt_zh: 虽然人工智能在数学推理方面取得了快速进展，但许多开放问题依赖于只有通过大规模计算探索和分析综合才能揭示的结构。 1933 年的莱默问题就是这样一个例子。它询问整数多项式的马勒测度（衡量其根偏离单位圆的距离）是否可以任意小。以前，仅针对偶数次 $d \le 180$ 系统地构造具有整数系数和小马勒测度的不可约多项式。在更高的度数上，Boyd 的分析单参数族经常进行因子分解，跳过近 50% 的目标度数，并且没有为任意 $d$ 留下任何一般构造。在这里，我们通过人类-人工智能发现循环来解决高度制度，其中我们通过快速数字管道、精确符号验证器和大规模分布式搜索来扩展对话提示。人工智能代理在本地构建数值和符号求解器原型，跨分布式集群启动并行搜索，并与人类研究人员合作提取和验证

items.title: RoleFlow: Self-Evolving Multi-Role Agentic Collaboration via Structural Adaptation
items.excerpt: Large language model (LLM) based multi-agent systems often rely on predefined collaboration structures, limiting their adaptability to evolving task requirements. Although recent approaches enable dynamic orchestration, trajectory-level rewards they apply assign one outcome to each decision, ofen struggling to identify the contributions of individual structural changes. We propose RoleFlow, a self-evolving multi-role agentic system that refines collaboration structures through feedback-driven atomic edits and on-demand role synthesis. To make structural adaptation learnable, we introduce Single-Edit Counterfactual Policy Optimization (SECPO), which evaluates each edit against its no-edit counterpart at the same chain state and assigns targeted credit to edit-specific tokens. Across seven benchmarks spanning four domains, RoleFlow achieves the optimal average performance, surpassing the strongest competitor by 4.7 points. It leads on all three multi-hop QA benchmarks by 3.2-7.5 F1 points and also shows supremacy on mathematical reasoning, web interaction, and code generation. Further analyses demonstrate cross-benchmark transferability
items.authors: Yi Ge, Pan Wang, Xuehao Cui, Zian Zeng, Xu Hu, Heng Huang, Furong Huang
items.title_zh: RoleFlow：通过结构适应自我进化的多角色代理协作
items.excerpt_zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统通常依赖于预定义的协作结构，限制了它们对不断变化的任务需求的适应性。尽管最近的方法可以实现动态编排，但它们应用的轨迹级奖励为每个决策分配一个结果，通常很难确定单个结构变化的贡献。我们提出了 RoleFlow，这是一种自我进化的多角色代理系统，它通过反馈驱动的原子编辑和按需角色合成来完善协作结构。为了使结构适应可学习，我们引入了单编辑反事实策略优化（SECPO），它在同一链状态下对照其无编辑对应项来评估每次编辑，并将目标信用分配给特定于编辑的代币。在跨越四个领域的七个基准测试中，RoleFlow 实现了最佳平均性能，比最强的竞争对手高出 4.7 个百分点。它在所有三个多跳 QA 基准测试中领先 3.2-7.5 个 F1 点，并且在数学推理、Web 交互和代码生成方面也表现出优势。进一步分析证明了跨基准可转移性

items.title: Same Beliefs, Different Policies: Learning Reusable Representations for Early Stopping in LLM Reasoning
items.excerpt: Reasoning LLMs often continue reasoning after reaching a correct answer, wasting computation and sometimes replacing it with an incorrect one. Deciding when to stop is a metareasoning problem: the model must weigh what further reasoning could achieve against its cost, given what it can already answer. Direct utility training learns a stopping representation at a chosen token price; supporting new prices can require additional controller training. We introduce BELT (BELief-based Termination), which separates outcome prediction from stopping control. It learns beliefs about current and future answers from a frozen LLM's hidden states, then fits a linear stopping policy on the frozen features. The prediction targets are independent of token price, so one probe supports different accuracy-cost trade-offs through CPU policy refitting or threshold adjustment. Averaged over five out-of-distribution (OOD) math benchmarks, BELT reduces generated tokens by 41% on Qwen3-1.7B and 51% on OLMo-3-7B-Think without loss of accuracy. items.title_zh: 相同的信念，不同的政策：学习可重用的表示以尽早停止 LLM 推理

items.title: From Single-Actor Environments to Multi-Actor Event Worlds: Can LLMs Be Event World Models?
items.excerpt: World models help agents assess the consequences of their actions before acting. Many real systems, however, involve multiple actors who make their own decisions, can evolve even when the agent takes no action, and are only partially observed through event logs. We formalize these systems as event worlds and ask whether large language models can predict future observations from the log and the agent's proposed actions. We build complementary benchmarks from human Diplomacy games and real Polymarket trades. Our hierarchical framework compares prediction with and without other actors' actions, then tests multi-step rollouts, predictions for actions never taken, and usefulness to agents. Fine-tuning and more data improve prediction when all actors' recorded actions are given. With only the agent's action, models struggle when other actors strongly affect the outcome, and larger models and longer histories help little. This gap also limits multi-step prediction and agent decisions, with models overestimating plan success. Yet imagined experience and initialization from world models can still improve policy learning. Anticipating other act
items.authors: Juntong Ni, Zewen Liu, Bohan Wang, Lige Zhang, Wei Jin
items.title_zh: 从单参与者环境到多参与者事件世界：LLM 可以成为事件世界模型吗？
items.excerpt_zh: 世界模型帮助主体在采取行动之前评估其行为的后果。然而，许多真实的系统涉及多个参与者，他们自己做出决定，即使代理不采取任何行动，也可以进化，并且只能通过事件日志进行部分观察。我们将这些系统形式化为事件世界，并询问大型语言模型是否可以根据日志和代理建议的操作来预测未来的观察结果。我们从人类外交游戏和真实的 Polymarket 交易中建立互补的基准。我们的分层框架将预测与其他参与者的操作进行比较，然后测试多步骤部署、对从未采取的操作的预测以及对代理的有用性。当给出所有参与者记录的动作时，微调和更多数据可以改善预测。当其他参与者强烈影响结果时，只有代理人的行动，模型就会陷入困境，而更大的模型和更长的历史则无济于事。这种差距还限制了多步骤预测和代理决策，模型高估了计划的成功。然而，想象的经验和世界模型的初始化仍然可以改善政策学习。预期其他行为

items.title: Model Organisms of Collusion: Corrective Transfer in Untrusted Monitors
items.excerpt: AI control protocols aim to get useful work from models that may be misaligned by monitoring their behaviour. One approach uses a second copy of the same model as the monitor. This avoids relying on a weaker reviewer the model could outsmart, but risks collusion: the model, now monitoring itself, may cover up its own misbehaviour. One remedy is to fine-tune the monitor on whatever examples of misbehaviour the control team has caught. We ask whether this training also removes collusion that the control team has not yet found. We fine-tune Llama-3.3-70B and Qwen2.5-72B to install five policy-monitor behaviour pairs, correct the monitor on 300 honest reviews of one caught collusion, and measure collusion on the other four in unseen prompt formats. Averaged over the three seeds of each family, correction reduces held-out collusion from 91% to 14-20% under three of the four methods we compare (individual seeds 10-32%), while a control fine-tuned on the same number of unrelated examples leaves 56-93%. items.title: Speculative Acceptance Does Not Decay with Position: A Full-Length Diagnostic on Long Chain-of-Thought with Independent Drafts
items.excerpt: The claim that speculative-decoding acceptance rate decays as a chain-of-thought grows longer has become a de facto industry narrative, motivating draft-model co-design and position-aware training. Nearly all direct evidence comes from trained drafters whose offline training length is far shorter than inference, so a purely positional law has never been isolated. We present the first systematic, full-length measurement of acceptance rate as a function of generation position on MATH-500 (all 500 problems), under greedy and sampling decoding, with two independent drafts against DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B: a same-family draft (DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B) and a cross-family draft (Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct), yielding about 1.78M verification rounds. Using within-problem paired tests, we find that after isolating a greedy-decoding repetition pathology, acceptance rate does not decay with position in any of the four configurations within the supported ranges (greedy 0-8K, sampling 0-12K); the second half of each trajectory is slightly but significantly higher than the first. items.title_zh: 投机性接受不会随立场而衰减：对独立草案的长思想链的全面诊断
items.excerpt_zh: 随着思想链变长，推测解码接受率会下降的说法已成为事实上的行业叙述，激励了草稿模型协同设计和位置感知培训。几乎所有的直接证据都来自训练有素的起草者，他们的离线训练时间远短于推理，因此纯粹的位置法则从来都不是孤立的。我们提出了第一个系统的、完整的接受率测量，作为 MATH-500（所有 500 个问题）上生成位置的函数，在贪婪和采样解码下，针对 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 提出了两个独立草案：同族草案 (DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B) 和跨族草案 (Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct)，产生约178 万轮验证。使用问题内配对测试，我们发现在隔离贪婪解码重复病理学之后，接受率不会随着支持范围内的四种配置中的任何位置而衰减（贪婪 0-8K，采样 0-12K）；每个轨迹的后半部分略高于前半部分，但明显较高。受控温度扫描表明表观采样莫

items.title: Algorithmic drift in generative adaptive learning
items.excerpt: Generative artificial intelligence promises to democratize personalized tutoring, yet the longitudinal stability of adaptive systems remains under-theorized. Current ethical discourse focuses on static bias. This paper argues that a distinct threat lies in algorithmic drift: a feedback loop in which minor, demographically asymmetric observation errors compound over time into systemic inequities. We make three contributions. First, we formalize algorithmic drift as a coupled learner--tutor dynamical system. Second, we corroborate this theory with an agent-based Monte Carlo simulation in which either a transparent online tracker or an LSTM deep-knowledge-tracing network drives an IRT-based curriculum policy. Third, we introduce the temporal fairness stabilizer (TFS), a targeted intervention that periodically re-probes learner capability, and benchmark it against standard exploration baselines with explicit group-fairness metrics and replication-level inference. items.title_zh: 生成自适应学习中的算法漂移
items.excerpt_zh: 生成式人工智能有望使个性化辅导民主化，但自适应系统的纵向稳定性仍然缺乏理论依据。当前的道德话语集中于静态偏见。本文认为，一个明显的威胁在于算法漂移：一个反馈循环，其中较小的、人口统计不对称的观察误差随着时间的推移会复合成系统性不平等。我们做出三项贡献。首先，我们将算法漂移形式化为耦合学习者-导师动力系统。其次，我们用基于代理的蒙特卡罗模拟证实了这一理论，其中透明的在线跟踪器或 LSTM 深度知识跟踪网络驱动基于 IRT 的课程政策。第三，我们引入了时间公平稳定器（TFS），这是一种有针对性的干预措施，可以定期重新探测学习者的能力，并通过明确的群体公平性指标和复制级推理将其与标准探索基线进行基准测试。在建模环境中，TFS 缩小了通用探索无法实现的成就差距，并且我们描述了它成功的条件。我们分开什么是

items.title: How Prompt Style Affects AI Accuracy and Speed in Competitive Programming
items.excerpt: Large language models are increasingly used in competitive programming, and their outputs are sensitive to how a prompt is phrased. Prior work has compared prompt strategies for accuracy on competitive programming, but not for runtime speed, and has not situated the results against human performance. In an exploratory study of one prompt in each of nine styles on GPT-5.5 across three accuracy tasks from the International Olympiad in Informatics (IOI) and two NP-hard speed tasks, we found that no single prompt was best: the strongest prompt depended on the task type and on whether results were summarized by the mean or the median, suggesting that, at least for these tasks, prompt style should be matched to the objective rather than treated as universal. Many differences in mean scores came from a few outlier runs, showing that evaluating prompting by a single metric can obscure how much its effectiveness varies. Compared descriptively with human IOI contestants, who worked under different conditions, the AI was neither strictly better nor strictly worse, exceeding the average contestant on one task but falling short on the other two. items.title_zh: 竞争性编程中提示风格如何影响人工智能的准确性和速度
items.excerpt_zh: 大型语言模型越来越多地用于竞争性编程，它们的输出对提示的措辞非常敏感。之前的工作比较了竞争性编程准确性的即时策略，但没有比较运行速度，并且没有将结果与人类表现进行比较。在一项对 GPT-5.5 上的九种提示风格的探索性研究中，涉及国际信息学奥林匹克 (IOI) 的三项准确性任务和两项 NP-hard 速度任务，我们发现没有一种提示是最好的：最强的提示取决于任务类型以及结果是按平均值还是中位数总结，这表明，至少对于这些任务，提示风格应与目标相匹配，而不是被视为通用。平均分数的许多差异来自一些异常值运行，这表明通过单个指标评估提示可能会掩盖其有效性的差异。与在不同条件下工作的人类 IOI 参赛者相比，人工智能既没有严格意义上的更好，也没有严格意义上的更差，在一项任务上超过了平均参赛者，但在其他两项上却落后了。乙

items.title: Edit, Don't Imitate: Minimal-Edit On-Policy Distillation for Multimodal Reasoning
items.excerpt: Visual mathematical reasoning can fail before reasoning begins: when a vision-language model (VLM) misreads a diagram, subsequent reasoning proceeds from false premises. This perceptual bottleneck is especially pronounced in smaller models, while accurate textual descriptions can substantially narrow the gap to larger models. Because obtaining such descriptions at inference requires additional annotation or model calls, we propose minimal-edit corrective on-policy distillation. Using reference figure descriptions and verified reference solutions as training-only information, a teacher scores incorrect student rollouts under a minimal-edit objective, and only teacher-disfavored tokens contribute to the corrective loss. Correct rollouts receive task-reward reinforcement learning. This preserves on-policy supervision while avoiding full-response imitation. Across model scales, the method requires no descriptions at test time and meets or exceeds the corresponding base model supplied with a reference figure description at inference. It also improves perception-oriented performance, particularly low-level geometric perception, and transfer
items.authors: Wen Ye, Ailin Deng, Zirui Wang, Shixing Yu, Han Zhang, Tian Yun, Nikhil Mehta, Tarun Kalluri, Xuefei Cao, Xuezhe Ma, Hengduo Li
items.title_zh: 编辑，不要模仿：多模态推理的最小编辑按策略蒸馏
items.excerpt_zh: 视觉数学推理可能会在推理开始之前失败：当视觉语言模型 (VLM) 误读图表时，后续推理会从错误的前提出发。这种感知瓶颈在较小的模型中尤其明显，而准确的文本描述可以大大缩小与较大模型的差距。由于在推理时获得此类描述需要额外的注释或模型调用，因此我们提出最小编辑校正策略蒸馏。使用参考图描述和经过验证的参考解决方案作为仅训练信息，教师可以在最小编辑目标下对不正确的学生展示进行评分，并且只有教师不喜欢的标记才会导致纠正损失。正确的部署会收到任务奖励强化学习。这保留了政策监督，同时避免了全响应模仿。在模型尺度上，该方法在测试时不需要描述，并且满足或超过在推理时提供参考图描述的相应基础模型。它还提高了面向感知的性能，特别是低级几何感知和迁移

items.title: Rethinking SAE Evaluation: An Atomic Interpretable Unit Framework Reveals Hidden Polysemanticity and Redundancy
items.excerpt: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) were originally motivated by discovering monosemantic features, a property that characterizes individual features but does not specify what the learned feature set should look like as a whole. As SAEs have increasingly been adopted for attribution, circuit discovery, and intervention, researchers have begun evaluating metrics that describe global properties of the feature set, such as sparsity, dead feature rates, reconstruction fidelity, and disentanglement, a diverse set that extends far beyond monosemanticity. However, this implicit shift beyond monosemanticity has not been formalized as a clear, well-defined objective that comes before these evaluation metrics. Without such an objective, existing metrics remain ad hoc, with their necessity unjustified. In this work, we formalize this ultimate objective by introducing a new paradigm for SAE evaluation: requiring that SAE features, and more generally dictionary-based decompositions of model representations, form an atomic interpretable unit basis, a coordinate system for semantically meaningful explanation.
