items.title_zh: 重新思考 SAE 评估：原子可解释单元框架揭示隐藏的多语义性和冗余
items.excerpt_zh: 稀疏自动编码器 (SAE) 最初的动机是发现单语义特征，该特征表征各个特征，但不指定学习的特征集作为一个整体应该是什么样子。随着 SAE 越来越多地被用于归因、电路发现和干预，研究人员已经开始评估描述特征集全局属性的指标，例如稀疏性、死特征率、重建保真度和解缠结，这是一个远远超出单一语义的多样化集合。然而，这种超越单一语义的隐含转变尚未被正式化为出现在这些评估指标之前的清晰、明确的目标。如果没有这样的目标，现有的指标仍然是临时的，其必要性是不合理的。在这项工作中，我们通过引入 SAE 评估的新范式来形式化这一最终目标：要求 SAE 特征以及更一般的基于字典的模型表示分解形成原子可解释单元基础，即语义上有意义的解释的坐标系。在这个范式下，我们组织现有的和n

items.title: Optimal Multitask Representations Under a Rate Constraint: An Information Bottleneck Analysis
items.excerpt: Which pretraining objective yields the best representation for downstream tasks under an information budget? We formalize this problem as a multitask information bottleneck, using a mutual information constraint to model incomplete information retention. For Gaussian inputs and tasks, we characterize optimal representations and show that a weakly task-aligned specialist can outperform a reconstruction generalist at low rates but lose at high rates. We also construct task families for which every fixed Gaussian prediction objective incurs arbitrarily large relative regret, driven by reversals in optimal allocation priorities. Conversely, the average task information matrix defines an objective with a uniform relative-regret bound controlled by maximum task SNR. CelebA and dSprites experiments illustrate that compression can change which pretraining objective performs best, and even task-aware training can reverse which downstream task is better preserved as rate increases.
items.title_zh: 速率约束下的最优多任务表示：信息瓶颈分析
items.excerpt_zh: 哪个预训练目标可以在信息预算下产生下游任务的最佳表示？我们将这个问题形式化为多任务信息瓶颈，使用相互信息约束来模拟不完整的信息保留。对于高斯输入和任务，我们描述了最佳表示，并表明弱任务对齐专家可以在低速率下胜过重建通才，但在高速率下会失败。我们还构建了任务族，其中每个固定的高斯预测目标都会因最优分配优先级的逆转而产生任意大的相对遗憾。相反，平均任务信息矩阵定义了一个目标，该目标具有由最大任务 SNR 控制的统一相对遗憾界限。 CelebA 和 dSprites 实验表明，压缩可以改变哪个预训练目标表现最好，甚至任务感知训练也可以随着速率的增加而逆转哪个下游任务得到更好的保留。

items.title: Solvable models of learning to pursue a moving target
items.excerpt: Agents tasked with intercepting a moving target must learn how to reach it, ideally as efficiently as possible. As observers of animal pursuit behavior have noticed, different strategies are possible: on one extreme, the agent reactively moves toward the target's current location; on the other, the agent predicts the target's future location and moves directly there. Motivated by the desire to understand how such strategies might be learned, we introduce a continuous-time linear-quadratic model of open-loop target pursuit whose optimal control strategies interpolate between these possibilities. Usefully, a small number of interpretable parameters control which type of strategy is optimal, and it is possible to derive closed-form solutions for optimal strategies, policy learning dynamics, and value learning dynamics. Exploiting our model's linear structure, we find that the time scales of learning precisely correspond to the eigenvalues of certain matrices, and that relevant eigenvalue spectra generically have a gap. We show that this gap indicates that agents tend to learn how to reach their target before optimizing their movement. Ou
items.title_zh: 追求移动目标的可解决学习模型
items.excerpt_zh: 负责拦截移动目标的特工必须学会如何到达目标，最好尽可能高效。正如动物追逐行为的观察者所注意到的，可能有不同的策略：在一种极端情况下，智能体反应性地向目标的当前位置移动；在另一种极端情况下，智能体会向目标的当前位置移动。另一方面，代理预测目标的未来位置并直接移动到那里。出于了解如何学习此类策略的愿望，我们引入了开环目标追踪的连续时间线性二次模型，其最佳控制策略在这些可能性之间进行插值。有用的是，少量可解释的参数控制哪种类型的策略是最优的，并且可以导出最优策略、策略学习动态和价值学习动态的封闭式解决方案。利用模型的线性结构，我们发现学习的时间尺度精确对应于某些矩阵的特征值，并且相关的特征值谱通常存在间隙。我们表明，这种差距表明智能体倾向于在优化其运动之前学习如何达到目标。欧

items.title: GIFT: Gradient Informed Filtering for Distillation Augmented Reasoning RL
items.excerpt: Training large language models for complex reasoning tasks relies on two complementary signals: sparse, outcome-grounded reinforcement learning (RL) for correctness, and dense, token-level distillation for guidance. However, complementarity in supervision does not guarantee compatibility in optimization; imitation-focused distillation can conflict with the outcome-driven RL objective, and existing hybrids lack a principled resolution. We propose \textbf{GIFT} (\textbf{G}radient-\textbf{I}nformed \textbf{F}il\textbf{T}ering for Distillation-Augmented Reasoning RL), a novel method that directly addresses the allocation problem of which teacher updates to apply. GIFT performs a token-level geometric analysis, decomposing the distillation gradient into a component \textbf{parallel} to the RL gradient, which measures first-order conflict and provides a \textbf{safety} filter, and a component \textbf{orthogonal} to it, which quantifies novel directional guidance and provides a measure of \textbf{value}. items.authors: Shijie Li, Yilin Gao, Tieyuan Chen, Yun Luo, Weiyao Lin, Hang Yu
items.title_zh: GIFT：用于蒸馏增强推理 RL 的梯度通知过滤
items.excerpt_zh: 为复杂的推理任务训练大型语言模型依赖于两个互补的信号：稀疏的、基于结果的强化学习（RL）以确保正确性，以及密集的、令牌级蒸馏以提供指导。然而，监督上的互补并不能保证优化上的兼容性；以模仿为中心的蒸馏可能与结果驱动的强化学习目标相冲突，而现有的混合方法缺乏原则性的解决方案。我们提出了 \textbf{GIFT} （\textbf{G}radient-\textbf{I}nformed \textbf{F}il\textbf{T}ering for Distillation-Augmented Reasoning RL），这是一种直接解决要应用哪些教师更新的分配问题的新颖方法。 GIFT 执行令牌级几何分析，将蒸馏梯度分解为与 RL 梯度平行的分量，它测量一阶冲突并提供安全过滤器，以及与其正交的分量，它量化新的方向指导并提供测量值。这种分解产生了一个原则性的评分规则来对代币级别的指导进行排名。我们将其与渐进式 \textbf{coverage annea 结合起来

items.title: Lean Finder V2: Semantic Search for Mathlib That Disambiguates User Queries
items.excerpt: We introduce Lean Finder V2, a semantic search framework for Mathlib that disambiguates user queries through complementary model-level adversarial training and input-level query rewriting. Human mathematicians and coding agents rarely search Mathlib by providing detailed context. In practice, they query short properties, notation, aliases, or hypotheses, leaving much of the intended mathematics implicit. In contrast, existing Mathlib search engines unrealistically assume context-rich queries. The scarcity of real-world short queries paired with ground-truth Mathlib statements makes this ambiguity even more intractable. We argue that this is essentially a data problem. Through adversarial training, we scale up the generation of labeled short and ambiguous queries, and learn to disambiguate user queries at both model-level fine-tuning and input-level query rewriting. On the human-curated MathlibQR benchmark, our Lean Finder V2 sets a new state of the art, with at least 11% relative improvement over the previous best Mathlib semantic search engines. items.authors: Jialin Lu, Xiaoyu Liu, Hengrui Luo, Rodrigo Stehling, Linxi Liu, Weiran Sun, Yuepeng Wang, Wuyang Chen
items.title_zh: Lean Finder V2：对 Mathlib 进行语义搜索，消除用户查询的歧义
items.excerpt_zh: 我们引入了 Lean Finder V2，这是 Mathlib 的语义搜索框架，它通过补充模型级对抗训练和输入级查询重写来消除用户查询的歧义。人类数学家和编码人员很少通过提供详细上下文来搜索 Mathlib。在实践中，它们查询简短的属性、符号、别名或假设，从而隐含了许多预期的数学内容。相比之下，现有的 Mathlib 搜索引擎不切实际地假设上下文丰富的查询。现实世界中短查询的稀缺与真实的 Mathlib 语句相结合使得这种歧义变得更加棘手。我们认为这本质上是一个数据问题。通过对抗性训练，我们扩大了带标签的短查询和模糊查询的生成，并学习在模型级微调和输入级查询重写中消除用户查询的歧义。在人工策划的 MathlibQR 基准测试中，我们的 Lean Finder V2 树立了新的技术水平，与之前最好的 Mathlib 语义搜索引擎相比至少有 11% 的相对改进。在我们最先进的检索器之上，优化的查询重写进一步提高了数学

items.title: Training Mixed-Monotone Neural Networks for Verification Without Set Propagation
items.excerpt: Most formal verification approaches for neural networks conservatively enclose the output set of the neural network. However, computing a tight output enclosure is in general computationally hard. We sidestep this challenge with a novel neural network architecture that realizes mixed-monotone functions as the difference of monotone subnetworks. By utilizing the theory on mixed-monotone systems, this reduces the computation of a tight output enclosure from complicated set propagation to two simple forward passes of opposite corners of an input interval. Moreover, because the size of the resulting enclosure is a closed-form function of the weights of the neural network, we can directly minimize it during training. We prove a lower bound on the size of any such enclosure, given by the total variation of the represented function generalized to several inputs, which makes it possible to compare the tightness of the enclosure against the optimum. Our evaluation on regression and dynamical-system benchmarks demonstrates that our training reduces the enclosure size to within 0.5% of the lower bound without sacrificing prediction accuracy. Com
items.authors: Jonas Fingerhut, Lukas Koller, Matthias Althoff
items.title_zh: 训练混合单调神经网络进行验证，无需集合传播
items.excerpt_zh: 大多数神经网络的正式验证方法都会保守地封闭神经网络的输出集。然而，计算紧凑的输出外壳通常在计算上是困难的。我们通过一种新颖的神经网络架构来回避这一挑战，该架构将混合单调函数实现为单调子网络的差异。通过利用混合单调系统的理论，这减少了紧密输出范围的计算，从复杂的集合传播到输入区间对角的两个简单的前向传递。此外，由于所得外壳的大小是神经网络权重的封闭函数，因此我们可以在训练期间直接将其最小化。我们证明了任何此类外壳尺寸的下限，由推广到多个输入的表示函数的总变化给出，这使得可以将外壳的密封性与最佳值进行比较。我们对回归和动力系统基准的评估表明，我们的训练将外壳尺寸减小到下限的 0.5% 以内，而不会牺牲预测精度。康姆

items.title: FusionEval: Benchmarking Model Fusion for Large Language Models
items.excerpt: Model fusion aims to integrate the capabilities of multi-expert models into a single model. Existing evaluations offer limited coverage of reasoning with long chains of thought and tool use, while strong average performance can mask substantial losses in individual expert capabilities. We introduce FusionEval, a benchmark that provides controlled expert pools, integrates fusion methods with and without additional training, and offers a unified evaluation suite. The pools contain domain experts independently trained from Qwen3 and Llama base models across math, code, science, instruction following, and tool use. The suite evaluates capability retention and computational cost on eight public benchmarks under comparable data access rules, reporting normalized average and worst performance, runtime, and peak GPU memory usage. Extensive experiments show that training-free methods preserve reasoning performance but substantially degrade tool use at both model scales. items.authors: Shuo Cai, Yanggan Gu, Yuhang Liu, Su Lu, Yuanyi Wang, Yang Yu, Zhen Li, Zhitian Hou, Guanghao Zhu, Ming Li, Hongxia Yang
items.title_zh: FusionEval：大型语言模型的基准模型融合
items.excerpt_zh: 模型融合旨在将多专家模型的功能集成到单个模型中。现有的评估对长链思维和工具使用的推理覆盖范围有限，而强大的平均表现可能掩盖个人专家能力的重大损失。我们推出 FusionEval，这是一个提供受控专家池的基准测试，集成了有或没有额外训练的融合方法，并提供了统一的评估套件。这些人才库包含经过 Qwen3 和 Llama 基础模型独立培训的领域专家，涉及数学、代码、科学、指令遵循和工具使用。该套件在可比较的数据访问规则下评估八个公共基准的能力保留和计算成本，报告标准化的平均和最差性能、运行时间和峰值 GPU 内存使用情况。大量实验表明，免训练方法可以保留推理性能，但会大大降低两种模型规模的工具使用率。相比之下，MOPD 保留了工具的使用并实现了更平衡的能力概况，但需要额外的数据准备、推理和培训。共同保留理由

items.title: What the Specification Did Not Say: Specification-Oracle Gaps in Test-Graded Coding-Agent Benchmarks
items.excerpt: Coding-agent benchmarks often describe a task in natural language but grade it with tests taken from the upstream project. Passing those tests can require information the description never states: a constant's name, a module path, an exact message. We call this a specification-oracle gap: where it exists, a benchmark also measures whether an agent reproduces upstream implementation details. We formalise the gap, including the inconsistencies that chains of dependent tasks add, and build a static audit for five languages that classifies every name-, path- and literal-level dependency of every scored test (held-out precision 89.2%, recall 92.9%). On SWE-Milestone (98 graded milestones, 35 published runs), 25 milestones contain a test that depends on an unstated, non-inferable name or path. Build units with such a dependency fail in 80.6% of runs, against 48.4% for comparable units without one, and withholding a single hidden name from the reference stops its unit's tests from compiling in 126 of 128 cases. items.title_zh: 规范中未提及的内容：测试分级 Coding-Agent 基准中规范 Oracle 的差距
items.excerpt_zh: 编码代理基准测试通常用自然语言描述任务，但根据上游项目的测试对其进行评分。通过这些测试可能需要描述中从未提及的信息：常量名称、模块路径、确切的消息。我们将其称为规范预言差距：如果存在这种差距，基准测试还会衡量代理是否重现上游实现细节。我们将差距正式化，包括依赖任务链增加的不一致，并为五种语言构建静态审计，对每个评分测试的每个名称、路径和文字级别依赖关系进行分类（保留精度 89.2%，召回率 92.9%）。在 SWE-Milestone（98 个分级里程碑，35 个已发布的运行）上，25 个里程碑包含一个依赖于未声明的、不可推断的名称或路径的测试。具有这种依赖关系的构建单元在 80.6% 的运行中失败，而没有这种依赖关系的类似单元的失败率为 48.4%，并且从引用中保留单个隐藏名称会阻止其单元的测试在 128 个案例中的 126 个案例中进行编译。排行榜的排名对于删除受影响的测试来说是稳健的，但它们会改变存储库内的分数并有利于代理

items.title: Delta N-gram: Forward-Only Continual Writing into a Language Model's Native N-gram Memory
items.excerpt: Our previous analysis found that a model's native hashed N-gram table is where continual updates disturb the base least, but its writes needed backpropagation and changed the pretrained table. We present Delta N-gram, a forward-only write path into that table. The pretrained table T^0 is never modified. Evidence is written into a sparse patch \Delta on the rows it addresses: a 4.1M-parameter writer emits a target and a gate per (position, hash head) event, and a block-averaged delta rule keeps each row a convex combination of its old value and the gated targets. The writer is trained offline on raw text with the pretraining objective; at use time writing takes forward passes only, and clearing \Delta restores the original model. A 0.6B prototype trained to answer questions keeps 16/16 facts after a second write; online gradient writes keep 2--4/16. We study two writers: a plain writer that encodes evidence with the T^0-only model, and a delta writer that reads its current memory while encoding. On Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, the plain writer's memory is document-specific: on 64 held-out news events it lowers continuation NLL by 0.068 nats/tok
items.title_zh: Delta N-gram：仅向前连续写入语言模型的本机 N-gram 内存
items.excerpt_zh: 我们之前的分析发现，模型的本机哈希 N 元语法表是连续更新对基础干扰最少的地方，但其写入需要反向传播并更改了预训练表。我们提出了 Delta N-gram，这是该表的只进写入路径。预训练表 T^0 永远不会被修改。证据被写入它所寻址的行上的稀疏补丁 \Delta 中：4.1M 参数编写器为每个（位置，散列头）事件发出一个目标和一个门，并且块平均增量规则使每行保持其旧值和门控目标的凸组合。作者根据预训练目标接受原始文本的离线训练；在使用时写入仅需要前向传递，并且清除 Delta 会恢复原始模型。经过训练来回答问题的 0.6B 原型在第二次写入后保留了 16/16 个事实；在线梯度写入保持2--4/16。我们研究了两个写入器：一个使用仅 T^0 模型对证据进行编码的普通写入器，以及一个在编码时读取其当前内存的增量写入器。在 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 上，普通作者的记忆是特定于文档的：在 64 个保留的新闻事件中，它将连续 NLL 降低了 0.068 nats/tok

items.title: Finitely Verifiable Segmentation: Decidability for Every Tokenizer with a Finite-State Verifier
items.excerpt: A segmentation policy assigns to each byte string at most one segmentation into tokens. Call it finitely verifiable when a finite automaton over marked strings, bytes paired with boundary bits, accepts exactly the policy's own segmentations. The automaton judges a proposed segmentation and need not compute one. The paper shows what that hypothesis buys. Four questions that practice settles by folklore become decidable, whether a window certifies a token boundary, whether the boundary gap is bounded, whether a mask keeps generation completable, and whether two policies are equivalent. The last three specialize limitedness, coaccessibility and the equivalence of single-valued transducers. The first refines the synchronizing cut of code theory, and two more ask whether a certified cut, or the cuts of an inventory, let each piece scan alone. The class sits strictly between the online-scannable policies and those with regular domains, and its inner frontier is Choffrut's and decidable in polynomial time. items.excerpt_zh: 分段策略为每个字节串分配至多一个分段标记。当标记字符串（与边界位配对的字节）上的有限自动机完全接受策略自己的分段时，将其称为有限可验证。自动机判断提议的分割并且不需要计算分割。这篇论文展示了这个假设的意义。实践通过民间传说解决的四个问题变得可判定：窗口是否证明令牌边界、边界间隙是否有界、掩模是否保持生成可完成以及两个策略是否等效。最后三个专门研究单值传感器的局限性、可访问性和等效性。第一个完善了代码理论的同步切割，另外两个询问是否经过认证的切割或库存的切割，让每个部分单独扫描。该类严格位于可在线扫描的策略和具有常规域的策略之间，其内部边界是 Choffrut 的并且可在多项式时间内判定。标记是保长的，所以类正是合理的分段策略，是一种范式而不是限制，

items.title: One Teacher, Many Views: Reducing Reference Sensitivity in On-Policy Self-Distillation
items.excerpt: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) improves reasoning by training a model on its own trajectories with dense token-level supervision from a privileged copy conditioned on a reference solution. Existing methods typically use a single teacher distribution conditioned on the complete reference. We identify a limitation of this formulation: a reference is only one realization of the reasoning process. Although it provides evidence about the answer, it also encodes an ordering, phrasing, and solution path. Full-reference conditioning can therefore produce correct targets that depend excessively on information unavailable to the student at inference. We show that replacing one valid reference with another, while holding the problem and student state fixed, can substantially alter the teacher distribution, a phenomenon we call reference-induced target instability. To address this instability, we introduce Monte Carlo Privileged Distillation (MCPD), which models privileged context as a distribution over partial reference views and distills the marginal teacher distribution. items.title_zh: 一位老师，多种观点：降低在策略自蒸馏中的参考敏感性

items.title: Inherited, Not Invented: Tracing the Provenance of Wait in Reasoning Models
items.excerpt: Reinforcement learning (RL) is credited with teaching reasoning models to write {wait} before reconsidering a step, yet large RL accuracy gains do not require the word. This view can confuse what RL discovers with what a model inherits from its training data. We trace the word through open models' training histories, reading it with label-free indices of frequency, position, form and usage and an injected-error test, all computed from sampled outputs. We find that zero-RL almost never coins the marker: on bases that lack the word, RL raises MATH-500 accuracy substantially while {wait} stays near absent. It arrives with training data: mid-training in OLMo-3, and fine-tuning on reasoning traces installs it in most models whose base lacks it. Where the base already uses it, both released RL-Zero recipes (OLMo-3, MiMo) multiply it, whereas KL-free GRPO from the same base does not; OLMo-3's recipe wears down its form and makes it a more sensitive but more liberal alarm; RL after supervised fine-tuning barely changes it, and our GRPO recipe erases a marker seeded by fine-tuning. items.title_zh: 继承，而非发明：在推理模型中追踪等待的起源

items.title: An Asymptotic for Non-Wieferich Numbers
items.excerpt: A cyclic number is a positive integer $n$ such that $\gcd(n, \varphi(n)) = 1$. Erd\H{o}s showed that the number of cyclic numbers up to $x$, $C(x)$, has $C(x) \sim e^{-\gamma}x/\log_3(x)$ asymptotically as $x$ tends to infinity. We define Wieferich numbers to be odd, positive integers $n$ such that $(n, (2^{\ell(n)}-1)/n) > 1$, where $\ell(n)$ is the smallest positive integer with $2^{\ell(n)} \equiv 1 \mod n$. Franco and Pomerance showed that non-Wieferich numbers have density zero among the odd integers. We show that the counting function of $n \leq x$ in the symmetric difference of non-Wieferich numbers and cyclic numbers is $O(x/(\log_3(x))^2)$, under a mild assumption on the counting function of Wieferich primes.
items.excerpt_zh: 循环数是一个正整数 $n$，使得 $\gcd(n, \varphi(n)) = 1$。 Erd\H{o}s 表明，直到 $x$ 的循环数 $C(x)$ 的数量，随着 $x$ 趋于无穷大，$C(x) \sim e^{-\gamma}x/\log_3(x)$ 渐近。我们将 Wieferich 数定义为奇数正整数 $n$，使得 $(n, (2^{\ell(n)}-1)/n) > 1$，其中 $\ell(n)$ 是 $2^{\ell(n)} \equiv 1 \mod n$ 的最小正整数。 Franco 和 Pomerance 证明，非 Wieferich 数在奇数整数中的密度为零。我们证明，在对 Wieferich 素数计数函数的温和假设下，非 Wieferich 数和循环数的对称差中 $n \leq x$ 的计数函数为 $O(x/(\log_3(x))^2)$。
